turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Cobweb
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At a psychiatric clinic for the elite, Dr. Stewart McIver (Richard Widmark) wants to institute a policy of self-governance among his patients. To further his goals, Dr. McIver proposes that residents collaborate to design and make new drapes for the clinic library. Though it seems inconsequential, trouble ensues when the clinic patients become locked in a power struggle with the equally unbalanced staff, including activities director Meg Rinehart (Lauren Bacall). (Drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Daytrippers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eliza D'Amico's seemingly idyllic marriage to Louis changes dramatically when she discovers what she believes to be a love letter to him from someone else. Going home to her family for comfort, Eliza sets out with her mother, father, sister and her sister's boyfriend in the family car to track down and confront Louis. Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweet November
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sara (Sandy Dennis), a free-spirited single woman living in Brooklyn, invites a new man to stay with her every month. For Sara, this is an opportunity to expose a man to new things, but it's also a way to make sure she will always be remembered by someone. Her latest boarder is Charlie (Anthony Newley), an uptight British businessman. Things, however, don't go as planned, and the two fall in love. Despite this, Charlie cannot stay any longer than his allotted month. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Outward Bound
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A group of strangers finds themselves aboard an unmanned ship, surrounded by fog and uncertain of their destination. As they attempt to make sense of their situation, the group of passengers, which include a man (Leslie Howard) and his long-lost mother (Beryl Mercer), discover that all they have in common is that each is dead and en route to their final judgment by Thompson (Dudley Digges). However, two desperate lovers, Henry (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.) and Ann (Helen Chandler), may be different. (Drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Smilin' Through
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On the day of his wedding, Sir John Carteret's fiancée, Moonyeen, is killed by a jealous rival named Jeremy, leaving him emotionally devastated. Carteret spends three decades in seclusion, mostly communing with the spirit of Moonyeen, until he learns that her niece, Kathleen (also Shearer), has become an orphan. He adopts and raises the child as his own but is alarmed when, as a young woman, she falls in love with the son of Moonyeen's murderer. (Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Romeo and Juliet
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this classic Hollywood take on Shakespeare's tragic romance, dashing young Romeo (Leslie Howard), a Montague, falls in love with the radiant Juliet (Norma Shearer), a member of the Capulet family, the Montagues' sworn enemies. Willing to defy the families' feud, the two secretly get married, however their happy day turns tragic when Juliet's cousin, Tybalt (Basil Rathbone) kills Romeo's best friend, Mercutio (John Barrymore), prompting Romeo to retaliate. (Romance) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Petrified Forest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this film adaptation of the Robert E. Sherwood play, a drifter, a waitress and a notorious gangster cross paths in the Petrified Forest region of Arizona. Alan (Leslie Howard), a destitute writer, goes into the diner where Gabrielle (Bette Davis) works. Gabrielle dreams of studying art, and she and Alan connect as they talk about Europe, and she tells him her ambitions. But gangster Duke Mantee (Humphrey Bogart) shows up and takes the customers hostage. (Drama) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It's Love I'm After
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Despite constant bickering on and offstage, Shakespearean actors Basil Underwood (Leslie Howard) and Joyce Arden (Bette Davis) intend to marry after their closing performance in "Romeo and Juliet." But following the show, debutante Marcia West (Olivia de Havilland), smitten by Basil's interpretation of Romeo, visits backstage to declare him the perfect man for her. Basil is initially flattered by her attentions, which enrages Joyce -- until they both find Marcia more than they can handle. (Comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Pygmalion
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When linguistics professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) boasts that he can pass off Cockney flower girl Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) as a princess with only six months' training, Colonel George Pickering (Scott Sunderland) takes him up on the bet. Eliza moves into Higgins's home and begins her rigorous training after the professor comes to a financial agreement with her dustman father, Alfred (Wilfrid Lawson). But the plucky young woman is not the only one undergoing a transformation. (Romantic comedy) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 49th Parallel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth (Eric Portman) attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as French-Canadian fur trapper Johnnie (Laurence Olivier) and soldier Andy Brock (Raymond Massey). (Thriller) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen. (Comedy) - 1975

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Brian Cohen (Graham Chapman) is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother (Terry Jones), the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate (Michael Palin) and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs. (Comedy) - 1979

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Monty Python's The Meaning of Life
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The stages of life are told through multiple sketches and songs by the British comedy troupe. The seven parts of life cover birth, growing up, war, middle age, organ transplants, old age and death. Not all stages are singular: "Part I: The Miracle of Birth" is from the perspective of an ignored woman in labor, and of a Roman Catholic couple with too many children, and "Part VII: Death" encompasses a funeral and heaven. Added are three unrelated skits placed in the beginning, middle and end. (Comedy) - 1983

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Yentl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rebbe Mendel is a single father who teaches the Talmud, a sacred text of Judaism, to the boys of his small Polish town. Behind closed doors, he also instructs his daughter, Yentl, despite the fact that girls are forbidden to study religious scripture. When Yentl's father dies, she still has a strong desire to learn about her faith -- so she disguises herself as a male, enrolls in a religious school, and unexpectedly finds love along the way. (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 1983

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: What's Up, Doc?
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two researchers have come to San Francisco to compete for a research grant in music. The man seems a bit distracted, and that was before he met a strange woman who has devoted her life to confusing and embarrassing him. At the same time a woman has her jewels stolen, and a government whistleblower arrives with his stolen top secret papers. (Comedy) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Elmer the Great
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Elmer Kane (Joe E. Brown) is an arrogant but gullible baseball player who must leave his Gentryville sweetheart, Nellie (Patricia Ellis), to join the Chicago Cubs. Once on board, his teammates take advantage of his gullibility with practical jokes, and the management hides the letters that come from Nellie. When she comes to Chicago to see him play the World Series, a series of misunderstandings and bad judgments threatens to ruin both his love life and career. (Comedy) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Random Harvest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Anthony Adverse
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Based on the novel by Hervey Allen, this expansive drama follows the many adventures of the eponymous hero (Fredric March). Abandoned at a convent by his heartless nobleman father, Don Luis (Claude Rains), Anthony is later mentored by his kind grandfather, John Bonnyfeather (Edmund Gwenn), and falls for the beautiful Angela Giuseppe (Olivia de Havilland). When circumstances separate Anthony and Angela, and he embarks on a long journey, he must find his way back to her, no matter what the cost. (Romance) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: They Won't Forget
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The town of Flodden is in an uproar when a pretty student is found dead on Confederate Memorial Day, but District Attorney Griffin (Claude Rains) sees it as an opportunity. Thinking the case could propel him into the U.S. Senate, he begins an extensive smear campaign against the girl's teacher, Robert Hale (Edward Norris), an outsider who hails from New York. Despite only circumstantial evidence, Hale is convicted, and locals threaten vigilante justice if he isn't executed. (Drama) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jaded World War I veteran James Allen (Paul Muni) dreams of creating a new life, but those dreams are shattered when he is implicated in a robbery and sentenced to 10 years on a chain gang. The brutal prison conditions compel James to break out and flee to Chicago, where he assumes a new identity and, over time, becomes a successful businessman. His freedom and happiness are threatened, however, when his scheming landlady (Glenda Farrell) discovers his secret and threatens to blackmail him. (Docudrama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Little Caesar
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An aspiring small-town criminal, Caesar "Rico" Bandello (Edward G. Robinson) relocates to Chicago to hit the big time, accompanied by his buddy, Joe Massara (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.). While Rico makes a name for himself in the underworld, Joe decides to leave the life of crime and ventures into show business, where he meets the lovely dancer Olga (Glenda Farrell). Though Rico and Joe try to honor their friendship, eventually their choices take them down dramatically different paths. (Crime drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: During World War II, Lt. Col. James H. Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads the U.S. Air Force in a bombing mission over Japan. Doolittle and his men stage a successful attack on Tokyo, but most pilots run out of fuel while returning from the raid. Many are forced to land on Japanese soil, but Capt. Ted Lawson (Van Johnson), who has a pregnant wife at home, crash-lands in the sea off the coast of China. Stranded, Lawson must heroically endure a series of harrowing challenges to make it back home. (War) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gaslight
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the death of her famous opera-singing aunt, Paula (Ingrid Bergman) is sent to study in Italy to become a great opera singer as well. While there, she falls in love with the charming Gregory Anton (Charles Boyer). The two return to London, and Paula begins to notice strange goings-on: missing pictures, strange footsteps in the night and gaslights that dim without being touched. As she fights to retain her sanity, her new husband's intentions come into question. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Angela Lansbury re-creates her Tony-winning performance of the opportunistic Mrs. Lovett, joining the macabre doings of the Demon Barber of Fleet Street, in Stephen Sondheim's Broadway musical. (Special, Musical, Drama, Thriller) - 1982-09-12

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Brides of Dracula
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt). (Horror) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blood From the Mummy's Tomb
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An archaeologist (Andrew Keir) and his team bring back an embalmed Egyptian princess who takes over his daughter (Valerie Leon). (Horror) - 1971

Along with Diamond Dog (Ving Rhames) and Baby-O (Mykelti Williamson), genius serial killer Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom (John Malkovich) unleashes a violent escape plot in mid-flight. Secretly working with U.S. Marshal Vince Larkin (John Cusack), Poe tries to foil Grissom's plan. (Action) - 1997

e!entertainmenttelevisionwest.us.title: Gone in 60 Seconds
e!entertainmenttelevisionwest.us.description: Randall "Memphis" Raines long ago abandoned his life of crime, but after an ominous visit from an old friend, he finds he has no choice but to return to what he does best -- stealing cars -- in order to save his brother's life. It all comes down to one night, 50 cars and a contract. (Action, Thriller) - 2000

e!entertainmenttelevisionwest.us.title: The Rock
e!entertainmenttelevisionwest.us.description: FBI chemical warfare expert Stanley Goodspeed (Nicolas Cage) is sent on an urgent mission with a former British spy, John Patrick Mason (Sean Connery), to stop Gen. Francis X. Hummel (Ed Harris) from launching chemical weapons on Alcatraz Island into San Francisco. Gen. Hummel demands $100 million in war reparations to be paid to the families of slain servicemen who died on covert operations. After their SEAL team is wiped out, Stanley and John deal with the soldiers on their own. (Action) - 1996

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Episode 6 Rick is on home turf when he visits the Tintagel area in Cornwall. Here, legend has it, the ruined castle atop the craggy, untamed cliffs is what remains of King Arthur's Camelot.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E37 Episode 37 Guest Sashi joins Justine on today's episode of Everyday Gourmet where she shares her Spiced Lamb Wrap recipe. Later, Justine makes a Tuna and Fennel Polpette and some Olive Oil Fried Potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E70 Pickles The one and only Peter Kuruvita and the one and only Dave Hughes make a dill with Adam tonight, they're all going to cook with pickles.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 North Scotland Rick and Chalky round off their journey of the UK at John O'Groats, visiting Rick's favourite deli in Edinburgh, a fish smokery in Argyll, enjoying freshly cooked lobster on Crail harbour front.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Get Up And Go Kickstart the day with unbeatable fast and fabulous breakfasts. From weekend parties to pancake feasts, working breakfasts, solo comforts and wake up shakes, Nigella's got mornings covered.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Rome Situated in Lazio, the ancient city of Rome is often overlooked in the gastronomic department. Stanley Tucci meets up with an old friend, Claudia della Frattina, and they head out to explore.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Torres Strait At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: E2 Wattleseed Damper With Golden Syrup Butter Torres Strait Islander chef and owner of Mabu Mabu, Nornie Bero, cooks and talks through some of her favourite easy recipes, from quick-pickled octopus to fresh-baked damper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Philadelphia Tony finally does Philadelphia! 36 hours of food, drink, history and art-and absolutely no cheesesteaks. Tony meets up with Marc Vetri for modern Israeli food at Michael Solomonov's Zahav.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Ishikawa In his wife's hometown, Adam Liaw uncovers the secrets to superb sake, samples some of the world's best sushi and prepares a classic Japanese dish with his mother-in-law.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E8 Wheat Harvest And Pasta Lidia talks the hard work involved with making flour, then bread and pasta. She makes croutons with a Caesar salad, then a fusilli with spinach and herbed ricotta, and a lagane pasta with chickpeas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E8 Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese Pati explores the culture of the mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Dining In Chef Mark loves throwing a dinner party for his friends and family. He's reviving the classic prawn cocktail, then an epic beef wellington, and lastly a trick to a make a creme caramel.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Travis Francis Lorraine Pascale creates a menu inspired by a student's Caribbean roots.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 A Chilli Love Story Noorman and Puti are a husband-and-wife duo who founded Nasi Lemak Ayam Taliwang, which combines the Singaporean Malay dish Nasi Lemak from Noorman's heritage, and the Indonesian dish Ayam Taliwang.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Broome: Pat Torres Gubinge Jam with Bush Fig & Bush Fig Cup Cakes with a Bush Passion Fruit Icing: Ali & Mitch join their cousin Pat to learn how to whip up some sweet treats using local bush fruits found in the region.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Aukra / Ona: Island Traditions and Innovation Exploring local delicacies, alternative farm schools and entrepreneurs making flake salt from ocean water on the rugged islands of Aukra and Ona; a gas processing plant that powers the U.K.; a modern salmon processing plant.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E13 Episode 13 Back in the market, Laura is joined by dietitian Simone Austin to prepare the ever-popular Bruschetta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 International Pub Cheese Burger Rachael takes the traditional beef burgers to the next level by adding homemade pub cheese topping, sauteed sweet onions, jalapeno peppers, and bacon on a pretzel bun, sealed with lettuce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E7 Cobden Hayden is heading to the heart of Australia's dairy country to see a dairy farm and butter factory in action, but first, we're at the iconic 12 Apostles for a start to the day we'll never forget.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Episode 3 We are serving up pure comfort today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E8 Episode 8 Laura makes Sushi accessible to the home cook before she heads to the famous wine region of the Barossa Valley and makes an Asian-inspired Chicken Noodle Stir Fry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E70 Pickles The one and only Peter Kuruvita and the one and only Dave Hughes make a dill with Adam tonight, they're all going to cook with pickles.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Leeks Leeks are not only a beautiful plant - they're a versatile asset in the kitchen. Jamie makes delicious pappardelle with slow-roasted leeks and a clever concertina squid with grilled leeks.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E9 Cooking With The Nuns Lidia went to school near Trieste and picked up many essential kitchen skills. Inspired by the soups in school lunches, she makes cannellini bean and lentil soup, and a one pot of sausages and apples.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E9 Hidden Guachochi Pati has a traditional meal with Raramuri community leaders and visits a sustainable ranch.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Menu One Chef Mark focuses on some classics - spaghetti carbonara using a few cupboard ingredients and a carrot cake. In his 'How To Perfect' series, Mark looks at some essential knife skills to up your game.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Sally Mack With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Crazy For Kueh Sandy and Elizabeth are a mother-daughter duo who founded Kueh Ho Jiak, which keeps the heritage of kueh (traditional Asian confectionery) and kueh-making alive.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Ali & Mitch Torres: Stinky Pearl Shell & Garlic Butter Pearl Meat Ali and Mitch share two recipes they grew up with that their father used to make - a condiment made from the intestines of the pearl shell and also a dish made from the muscle of the shell.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E8 Austevoll / Barentshavet: Snow Crab In Arctic Waters Take an unforgettable adventure to Austevoll and the Barents Sea, where coastal culture, sustainable fishing and local history come to life.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E14 Episode 14 Chef Mod joins Laura in the market to cook his wonderful Thai Beef Salad. Up next, farmer Catherine Velisha and chef Charlie Carrington have some fun with Charlie's dish, Cucumber and Prawn Tacos.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 Rabbit Ragu Rachael teaches how to prepare rabbit ragu, a traditional Tuscan recipe that combines ground rabbit, vegetables, wine, and more to make a thick sauce served over long pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E8 Port Douglas From rural Victoria to Tropical North Queensland - it doesn't get much better! Hayden heads back to Queensland for the Taste Port Douglas food festival.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Episode 4 Josep Espuga makes his famous caramelized Burnt Basque Cheesecake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E9 Episode 9 There's a hint of Korea in the Prahran Market as Laura prepares her take on a Beef Bibimbap with Gochujang Sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Episode 7 In the Clovelly area of North Devon, Rick goes fishing for herring with Steve Perham, whose family have been fishermen for over 200 years.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E38 Episode 38 Everyday Gourmet takes your tastebuds on an adventure on today's episode where they show you recipes from Petit Sale Pork and Lentils to Sardine Escabeche to Portugese Rice Pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E71 A Meal To Remember It's an unforgettable night on The Cook Up, as Adam and his guests, chefs Stephannie Liu and Brian Cole, each make a meal to remember!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Justine travels from Darwin to Kakadu exploring the Ubirri Rock Art walk, where she prepares a picnic lunch by the stunning Maguk Pools and experiences a pop up dining experience like no other.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Analiese starts her first Tasmanian Spring with a 'Welcome to Country' ceremony. She learns to shoot and goes on an overnight fishing adventure before laying down roots in her new native garden.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Gascoyne, WA Matt Moran visits Western Australia's Gascoyne Region and prepares dishes inspired by local bananas, avocadoes, crab and Pink Snapper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Sao Paulo Sao Paulo, a city Tony now loves. Tony catches up with old friends to taste the best of Brazilian fine dining at D.O.M.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Mie And Aichi Adam Liaw discovers and devours some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef in Japan before meeting a 74-year-old who still free-dives for precious abalone.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Winter Veg It may be November but the garden is still offering up some beautiful winter veg. Jamie explores what the garden has proffered and takes his finds to the kitchen to make a Winter Veg Coleslaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E10 The Winter Vegetable Patch Winter is always a tough time for the garden but makes cold weather crops more valuable. Some recipes include - orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and a cabbage salad with dressing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Rising In Adversity Audrey Chew is the founder of You Tiao Man, which brings the humble hawker fried dough stick youtiao to the wider manufacturing stage.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Menu Two Chicken is the focus, and Mark has some techniques to share. Some recipes include, a chicken bacon broccoli crumble and a Thai-inspired green curry. Mark shows us how to break down a whole chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Easy Entertaining The show is brimming with recipes that are perfect for a whole host of occasions from an impromptu dinner with friends to fresh and fun party food.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Tales
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 The New Age Hawkers Paul and Yu Jie are a young couple who founded Craft'B, which serves up modern rice bowls in Singapore's Central Business District.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Clifton Mamid: Tempura Fish & Blachung With Asian Style Salad Clifton Mamid is a trained chef who draws on his grandfather's Malaysian influence and whips up three separate dishes that make for a scrumptious meal.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Best In Season Maggie searches for the perfect tomato which she then uses to make a tomato bruschetta. Simon, not to be outdone, makes his own version of bruschetta using pear and goats cheese.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E15 Episode 15 Vegan Liz Douglas teaches Laura her healthy Chocolate Chia Mousse.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Artichokes Two Ways Rachael honors her beloved grandfather by making his recipe for stuffed artichokes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E9 Townsville Just off Townsville is the famous Magnetic Island which is Hayden's destination, but first he heads out to meet a young sweet potato farmer, and pick up some pineapples.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Episode 5 Dan Pasquali's brings a bit of flair to his crispy, nutty Pistachio Cookies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E10 Episode 10 of Season 9 Laura Sharrad cooks Singaporean laksa in the Prahran Markets; Chef Masa from Asian Inspirations joins Laura and cooks beef curry udon; Catherine Velisha makes baked fennel salad; Laura prepares fridge clean-out frittata from hydrogen home kitchen.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 Episode 8 Rick and Chalky travel to Loch Torridon in Scotland to go fishing with John McGreggor for langoustines. Here the prawns are protected by the Marien Stewardship Council.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dance With Tom
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Nyunga - The Sun Tom teaches a Nyunga dance. Nyunga is the Yugambeh word for Sun, which is the source of our energy! Join Tom for a Nyunga dance to warm your body and help you start your day!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Media Stamped
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Screentime is Yummy Is \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Brilliant World Of Tom Gates
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E14 Pe Lesson Tom's in his PE lesson but the playground wall is being painted, so the class must be careful. Liz shows us how to turn paint plodges into amazing doodles.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Know It Alls: Visual Art
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E9 Shared History Comedian Rodney Todd and Xavier will go on a fact-finding mission to understand how differing perspectives can show a viewer different sides to the one story and change our opinions.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E182 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E7 Glass Lodge, Treehouse and Doctor Who Shed George goes to Scotland to meet up with a farmer creating a flat pack, live in, caravan-shaped treehouse and visits a Macclesfield first-time builder hoping an old shed can be transformed into a Dr Who-inspired play-den.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E9 Lucy Lucy tells Lee that she is going for an interview and that if she gets the job she will spend a lot less time in the flat. Lee spends time in the bar with Toby worrying that the woman of his dreams is drifting further away.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 A germ warfare emergency response exercise begins in the MI5 office. Initially the team groans, but as the exercise progresses, they begin to doubt as to whether it's just a training scenario.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Luminaries
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 The Old Moon in the Young Moon's Arms Anna is tried for murder. New evidence reveals a secret connection between Lauderback and Crosbie Wells. Emery is found. Moody, Anna and he concoct a defence to expose Lydia and Carver's crimes. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E10 A Miracle Happens Here Christmas spirits are lifted when a patient resembling Santa visits the ER. Greene becomes enraged when Jenn decides to stay in Milwaukee with their daughter for the holidays. A priest's death threatens to start a gang war.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E6 Joints This episode is all about Joints. The body of the panel is made up of the sharp elbows of Jack Whitehall; shapely angles of Cal Wilson, cold shoulders of Jimmy Carr and hip hip hooray, it's Alan Davies!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E4 Cush Jumbo, Judi Love, Sir Grayson Perry & Tim Vine Rob Brydon is back as host with team captains Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Cush Jumbo, Judi Love, Sir Grayson Perry and Tim Vine.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E29 Viewer Special 2 On the first Viewer’s Special, Episode #85, we tested a bunch of myths from the fan site, and it was a blast, literally. But fortunately, for every myth we test, our fans have a bunch more.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E8 Fire Engine and Pony Trailer George meets a teacher converting an old horse box into a holiday trailer, and Britain's only female ice sculptor who's been tasked with furnishing the inside of a new ice bar in Liverpool with an enchanted forest theme.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E5 Robert Rinder, Katie Piper And Don Letts In this fifth heat, nine artists are challenged to create a portrait of one of three celebrities: criminal barrister Robert Rinder; author, model and presenter Katie Piper and film maker, musician and DJ Don Letts.

And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. discoverywest.us.title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E06 Invisible Weapon of War Andrew tests a disturbing theory: is a secret, directed-energy weapon used in Venezuela the smoking gun behind unexplained attacks on U.S. government officials overseas?

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E08 Secrets of the Drug War Going deeper while investigating the modern war on drugs, testing theories around the question: if the war is real, why are drug cartels more wealthy and powerful than ever?

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
discoverywest.us.description: S01 E02 Jersey Drone Panic When a swarm of craft floods New Jersey's skies, panic erupts online; Andrew digs into every conspiracy theory, interviewing eyewitnesses and testing cutting-edge drone tech, until he uncovers the truth behind the incident.

discoverywest.us.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups

fxm.us.description: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind. (Drama) - 2023

fxm.us.title: Let's Make Love
fxm.us.description: One of the wealthiest men in the world, Jean-Marc Clement (Yves Montand) is rich in money, but lacking in love. While seeking someone who adores him for his personality rather than his fortune, Clement learns that he is the subject of a satirical theater production. Unrecognized as he visits the play's set, Clement is offered the part as himself by the show's unwitting producers, and he takes the gig to be close to the gorgeous yet down-to-earth actress Amanda Dell (Marilyn Monroe). (Musical comedy) - 1960

fxm.us.title: High Anxiety
fxm.us.description: Just after becoming the director of the Psychoneurotic Institute for the Very, Very Nervous, Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke is greeted by a series of mysterious events. When his colleagues -- including the militaristic and mustachioed Nurse Diesel -- become leery of his questions, they accuse him of murder. Thorndyke's own mental health comes into question as he struggles to clear his name in the midst of a crippling bout of a condition known as high anxiety. (Comedy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Detective
fxm.us.description: When a gay man is viciously slain, Detective Joe Leland (Frank Sinatra) is put on the case. Joe eventually tracks down the victim's roommate, who confesses to the crime and is sentenced to death; however, the outcome of the case doesn't sit well with the detective. Norma (Jacqueline Bisset), a distraught widow, visits Joe. She believes her husband's death was no accident, but the cops don't seem to care. Joe begins to investigate, and stumbles on a cover-up related to his previous case. (Crime drama, LGBTQ) - 1968

fxm.us.title: The French Connection
fxm.us.description: New York Detective Popeye Doyle (Gene Hackman) and his partner (Roy Scheider) chase a French heroin smuggler. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1979

fxm.us.title: Alien: Romulus
fxm.us.description: Space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life-form in the universe while scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station. (Science fiction, Horror) - 2024

fxm.us.title: Aliens
fxm.us.description: After floating in space for 57 years, Lt. Ripley's shuttle is found by a deep space salvage team. Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine-year-old girl named Newt. But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 1986

fxm.us.title: Alien 3
fxm.us.description: Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) is the only survivor when she crash lands on Fiorina 161, a bleak wasteland inhabited by former inmates of the planet's maximum security prison. Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

fxm.us.title: Alien Resurrection
fxm.us.description: Two hundred years have passed since Ellen Ripley died on Fiorina 161. Aboard the medical research vessel USM Auriga, a team of scientists clones Ripley from her extracted DNA and removes the alien Queen embryo which was growing inside her at the time of her death. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1997

fxm.us.title: Alien: Romulus
fxm.us.description: Space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life-form in the universe while scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station. (Science fiction, Horror) - 2024

fxm.us.title: FXM Presents
fxm.us.description: An examination of the process of making movies follows a production from script to screen. (Entertainment) - 2012-01-01

fxm.us.title: Enemy Mine
fxm.us.description: During a war between humans and the reptilian Drac race, spaceship pilot Willis Davidge ends up stranded on an alien world, along with enemy fighter Jeriba Shigan. While both Willis and his Drac counterpart can breathe on the planet, the environment and its creatures are relatively hostile, forcing the two to work together to survive. As time goes by, Willis and Jeriba become unlikely friends, though their unique relationship faces considerable challenges. (Science fiction) - 1985

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Alligator People
fxm.us.description: Newly married nurse Joyce Webster (Beverly Garland) doesn't know what to think when her husband, Paul (Richard Crane), disappears during a train ride. She hires private investigators and eventually tracks him to an old bayou plantation, where the owner (Frieda Inescort) insists she's never heard of Paul. Joyce sticks around anyway and soon learns that local doctor Mark Sinclair (George Macready) has been using a life-altering alligator serum on the town's residents, and that Paul is among them. (Horror) - 1959

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Witchcraft
fxm.us.description: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Fury
fxm.us.description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza (Kirk Douglas) from his son, Robin (Andrew Stevens), the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress (John Cassavetes), who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian (Amy Irving), a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin. (Thriller, Horror) - 1978

fxm.us.title: Arachnophobia
fxm.us.description: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

fxm.us.title: The Grudge
fxm.us.description: A detective investigates a murder scene that has a connection to a case that her new partner handled in the past. The killings occurred in a haunted house that passes on a ghostly curse to those who dare enter it. Soon, the curse spreads to a terminally ill woman and her husband, and another unsuspecting couple who were in the wrong place at the wrong time. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Disturbia
fxm.us.description: Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him. (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Due Date
5starmax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
5starmax.us.description: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

5starmax.us.title: Switch
5starmax.us.description: Steve Brooks (Perry King), a sexist womanizer, is killed by a group of his angry former lovers. In heaven, he makes a bargain with God for redemption and agrees to return to Earth. Once there, he must have a sincere relationship with a female and make her fall in love with him. If not, Steve's soul will become the property of the devil (Bruce Martyn Payne). But the devil hedges his bet, and Steve is reincarnated as a woman named Amanda Brooks (Ellen Barkin). (Fantasy) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Science fiction) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: The Hobbit
5starmax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Science fiction) - 1972

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
5starmax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Just Friends
5starmax.us.description: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart. (Romantic comedy) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Son of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
5starmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: The Switch
5starmax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Scanners
5starmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah

5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Science fiction) - 1955

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
5starmax.us.description: Time-travelers' efforts to prevent a dinosaur's mutation result in the creation of a three-headed dragon that terrorizes Japan. (Science fiction) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: A Streetcar Named Desire
5starmax.us.description: Based on the play by Tennessee Williams, this renowned drama follows troubled former schoolteacher Blanche DuBois (Vivien Leigh) as she leaves small-town Mississippi and moves in with her sister, Stella Kowalski (Kim Hunter), and her husband, Stanley (Marlon Brando), in New Orleans. Blanche's flirtatious Southern-belle presence causes problems for Stella and Stanley, who already have a volatile relationship, leading to even greater conflict in the Kowalski household. (Drama) - 1951

5starmax.us.title: Catfish
5starmax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Man
5starmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Player
5starmax.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: The Blue Planet - The Blue Planet
bbcamerica.us.description: Oceans dominate the world's weather systems while supporting a wide range of life. (Documentary, Nature, Animals, Travel, Miniseries) - 2001-09-12

bbcamerica.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning
bbcamerica.us.description: Chrissie and her friends set out on a road trip for a final fling before one is shipped off to Vietnam. Along the way, bikers harass the foursome and cause an accident that throws Chrissie from the vehicle. The lawman who arrives on the scene kills one of the bikers and brings Chrissie's friends to the Hewitt homestead, where young Leatherface is learning the tools of terror. (Horror) - 2006

bbcamerica.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
bbcamerica.us.description: In this remake of the horror classic, a group of young travelers, including Erin, Andy and Morgan, comes across an isolated rural home while driving through Texas. Unfortunately for them, the decrepit house is the residence of a family of deranged backwoods killers, most notably a hulking masked brute known as Leatherface, who begins to hunt the stranded youths down. Will any of the friends survive the nightmarish ordeal? (Horror) - 2003

bbcamerica.us.title: The Crazies
bbcamerica.us.description: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

bbcamerica.us.title: The Last House on the Left
bbcamerica.us.description: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

bbcamerica.us.title: House of Wax
bbcamerica.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

bbcamerica.us.title: Thirteen Ghosts
bbcamerica.us.description: A state-of-the-art remake of the classic William Castle horror film about a family that inherits a spectacular old house from an eccentric uncle. There's just one problem: the house seems to have a dangerous agenda all its own. Trapped in their new home by strangely shifting walls, the family encounters powerful and vengeful entities that threaten to annihilate anyone in their path. (Horror, Thriller) - 2001

bbcamerica.us.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
bbcamerica.us.description: Fifteen years after Hansel (Jeremy Renner) and Gretel (Gemma Arterton) defeated the wicked witch who planned to have them for her dinner, the siblings have come of age as skilled bounty hunters. Hell-bent on retribution, they have dedicated their lives to hunting down and destroying every witch still lurking in the dark forests of their homeland. As the notorious blood moon approaches, the siblings face a great evil -- one that could hold the secret to their terrifying past. (Fantasy, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Legion
bbcamerica.us.description: For the patrons and staff at a dusty roadside diner, the day begins as usual, but when the phones go out and a sweet old lady goes on the attack, it's a harbinger of the terror to come. As the horrifying nature of the situation sinks in, help arrives in the form of the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany), who tells a pregnant waitress that her unborn baby is humanity's last hope, and he will do anything to protect it. (Horror, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2010

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E05 The Exterior Exorcism And then there were three! For the first time, each designer tackles a space of their own as they transform Bihl Manor's neglected exterior. Battling the spirits and the elements, they're aiming to give the grounds a glow-up worthy of the judges.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Shock
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 Surprising Their Parents A brother and sister look to give their parents thanks by surprising them with a dream renovation; with the help of Arielle and Steve, they aim to transform the family room into a cozy retreat while honoring their Indian heritage.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S211 E03 Leaving Big Pharma for Tulum, Mexico Overburdened by a career in big pharma, a German woman decided to leave it all to travel the world and fell in love with Tulum, Mexico. She's looking to purchase her first home, but her extensive wish list may not match her budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S209 E08 From Zambia to Phnom Penh City Streets After six years teaching in rural Zambia, a family is ready for their next adventure in Phnom Penh, Cambodia; with new jobs ahead and school starting soon, they're looking for a home that helps their kids adjust to a culture they barely know.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S207 E03 London Artist Takes on the Australian Outback A British artist looks to focus on growing her art tour business and permanently relocate to Alice Springs, Australia; she's looking for a big block of land with nature views to run workshops, but it may not match the size of her budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S200 E06 Big Ben and Big Decisions in London A Seattle family of five looks to relocate for a job opportunity to London; he wants to be close to the action with enough space to entertain, but she's the only one working and prefers an easy commute and a place that's comfortable for the family.

hgtvwest.us.title: Crashers
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E11 Spa Day Every Day Jon Knight and his team transform a couple's outdated primary suite in just 72 hours; it's a cold, disconnected bedroom and bathroom that feels like a motel, and they're aiming to create a cohesive, spa-like retreat built for rest and connection.

hgtvwest.us.title: Crashers
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Crooked Kitchen Jon Knight and his team crash Nick and Nia's poorly designed, dysfunctional kitchen, transforming an outdated space that simply doesn't work for their family's needs into a sleek, functional hub where they can finally cook, gather, and connect.

hgtvwest.us.title: Farmhouse Fixer
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E07 Clam Shack Chic A clam shack once residing on a nearby island was transformed into a home; Jon and Kristina come to the rescue and pull from its seaside history to create a bright space that's perfect for humans and felines alike.

hgtvwest.us.title: Farmhouse Fixer
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E06 Berry Farm Charm For the first time ever Jon and Kristina renovate a home on a working berry farm; using salvaged pieces found on the farmstead, they design a glass bottle wall, a hanging plant feature, and completely transform the space.

hgtvwest.us.title: Farmhouse Fixer
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E05 Saved by the Barn Jon and Kristina come to the rescue for a homeowner who is struggling with a post and beam barn; the barn is a party zone and includes a speakeasy, woodworking, a book club, a teen zone and life-size beer pong.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Enter if You Dare Four designers remain in the competition to bring the once-grand Bihl Manor back to life; split into two teams, they'll revive the haunted halls on the first and second floors, but will the spirits and judges approve?

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 A Game of Haunts The four remaining designers split into two teams to transform the attic into both a spooky speakeasy and a gothic game room; but first, a spine-tingling game brings haunted surprises, pushing their nerves and upcycled feature projects to the limit.

hgtvwest.us.title: A Very Haunted Renovation
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E05 The Exterior Exorcism And then there were three! For the first time, each designer tackles a space of their own as they transform Bihl Manor's neglected exterior. Battling the spirits and the elements, they're aiming to give the grounds a glow-up worthy of the judges.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E02 Horror in the Ominous Ozarks Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Ominous Ozarks where three homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a home of devilish doppelgängers and a ghostly gangster meeting place.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Eeriest of the East Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Eerie East where four homes vie for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a ghoulish home overrun with ghosts and a Victorian infested with spiders and apparitions.

hgtvwest.us.title: Scariest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E04 Scares of the Mysterious Midwest Retta's journey takes her to the Mysterious Midwest where four homes contend for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a ghostly home with a history of squatters and a Victorian full of ghosts and dolls.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E01 Back to the Wild Kicking things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside; exploring a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E03 Ranch Dressing Jack McBrayer searches for wild homes and goes chugga-chuggin' down to a cozy train caboose hideaway; next, he dreams in color at a pastel-painted ranch and stops by a desert dream oasis; only one home can reign supreme!

hgtvwest.us.title: Zillow Gone Wild

fxwest.us.description: As the son of Odin (Anthony Hopkins), king of the Norse gods, Thor (Chris Hemsworth) will soon inherit the throne of Asgard from his aging father. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

metvplus.us.title: Hawaii Five-O
metvplus.us.description: Detective Steve McGarrett (Jack Lord) heads up Hawaii Five-O, a special division of the state police tasked with bringing down organized crime on the islands. The Five-O team works with local police from time to time on individual cases, and McGarrett's nemesis is crime kingpin Wo Fat. The show, which ran for 12 seasons during its original run, is famous for its catchphrase "Book 'em, Danno," said by McGarrett at the end of most episodes. The show's theme song, composed by Morton Stevens, became popular during the show's original run. (Crime drama) - 1968-09-20

hdnetmovies.us.title: Death Race 2000
hdnetmovies.us.description: In the year 2000, America is a totalitarian regime on the brink of collapse. The most popular sport in this dystopia is the Transcontinental Road Race, where teams earn points for logging the fastest time and for mowing over the most innocent pedestrians in the process. This year's competitors include Frankenstein (David Carradine), who is rumored to be more machine than man, and the tough-as-nails "Machine Gun" Joe Viterbo (Sylvester Stallone). Some have a plan to stop the race. (Action, Comedy) - 1975

hdnetmovies.us.description: Nano's number one selling hearing aid is the cost-efficient solution to hearing loss. Easy to purchase - no doctor needed! (Health, Science, Technology, Consumer)

hdnetmovies.us.title: Paid Programming
hdnetmovies.us.description: Paid programming. (Consumer, Shopping, Variety)

hdnetmovies.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
hdnetmovies.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault. (Western) - 1974

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Sheriff
hdnetmovies.us.description: A small-scale gold rush erupts in a Colorado town after treasure is found in a grave. The area quickly becomes a magnet for criminals and other ne'er-do-wells, but everyone is too intent on searching for gold to consider law and order. When Jason McCullough (James Garner), a clever and supremely laid-back gunslinger, wanders into town, he becomes the de facto lawman, aided by local eccentric Jake (Jack Elam). McCullough's ingenuity is tested, however, when he runs afoul of the tough Danby gang. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

hdnetmovies.us.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
hdnetmovies.us.description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out. (Western, Comedy) - 1971

hdnetmovies.us.title: Bonanza - Enter Mark Twain
hdnetmovies.us.description: Newspaperman Samuel Clemens (Howard Duff), writing as Mark Twain, battles a judge involved in land fraud. (Drama, Western) - 1959-10-10

hdnetmovies.us.title: The Long Riders
hdnetmovies.us.description: During a bank robbery by the legendary James-Younger Gang, Ed Miller (Dennis Quaid) impulsively kills a man, much to the displeasure of leader Jesse James (James Keach), who insists that the gang scatter until the heat is off. The groups of brothers go their separate ways, with Cole Younger (David Carradine) considering settling down with his feisty girlfriend, Belle Starr (Pamela Reed). But they soon regroup for an ill-fated bank job in Northfield, Minn., that results in an epic chase. (Western, Biography) - 1980

hdnetmovies.us.title: Mississippi Burning
hdnetmovies.us.description: When a group of civil rights workers goes missing in a small Mississippi town, FBI agents Alan Ward (Willem Dafoe) and Rupert Anderson (Gene Hackman) are sent in to investigate. Local authorities refuse to cooperate with them, and the African American community is afraid to, precipitating a clash between the two agents over strategy.
