retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: SIGN OFF
retroplex.us.description: Sign off. (Special) - 2005-10-13

retroplex.us.title: West to Glory
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Colorado Serenade
retroplex.us.description: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe). (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Black Hills
retroplex.us.description: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: Return of the Lash
retroplex.us.description: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash. (Western, Action, Comedy) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Brother Outlaw
retroplex.us.description: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter. (Western) - 1971

retroplex.us.title: Down Missouri Way
retroplex.us.description: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright). (Musical comedy) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Pit Pony
retroplex.us.description: A horse's companionship helps a boy overcome his fears and work in a Nova Scotia coal mine to support his family. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: The Magnificent Matador
retroplex.us.description: An aging matador (Anthony Quinn) faces fear as he loves a rich American (Maureen O'Hara) and guides his son (Manuel Rojas) in the bullring. (Romance) - 1955

retroplex.us.title: The Treasure
retroplex.us.description: An old sea captain helps three young friends solve the 30-year-old case of a missing lighthouse keeper. (Mystery) - 1990

retroplex.us.title: Back to the Secret Garden
retroplex.us.description: Camilla Belle stars as Lizzie Buscana, a spirited orphan girl, in this sequel to the beloved adaptation of Frances Hodgson Burnett's novel. Lady Mary Craven, the original heroine, now an adult, befriends Lizzie and invites her to move from Brooklyn to Misselthwaite Manor, which is now an orphanage. After hearing about the secret garden, Lizzie is disappointed upon arriving to find it in a state of decay, and she endeavors to restore the garden to its past splendor. (Children, Fantasy, Drama) - 2000

retroplex.us.description: During an extended honeymoon in Europe, a restless wife (Mena Suvari) tests her husband's (Jack Huston) devotion by inviting a sultry Italian woman into their inner circle. (Drama, Romance) - 2008

retroplex.us.description: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
retroplex.us.description: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.description: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help. (Western) - 1946

But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Lightning Raiders
retroplex.us.description: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains. (Western) - 1945

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Cry Me An Allium River
tastemade.us.description: Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece. (Cooking) - 2022-03-25

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Frankie's Italian Faves
tastemade.us.description: Everyone knows Frankie can't live without pasta, but this week he shares his favorite Italian recipes that don't require any kneading. Add these simple, delicious dishes to your weeknight menu to complete your Italian dish repertoire. (Cooking) - 2023-10-27

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - A Cruciferous Delicious Time
tastemade.us.description: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they've become a fixture in Frankie's meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time. (Cooking) - 2021-04-02

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Summer Cookout
tastemade.us.description: Soak up summer with the ultimate outdoor cookout, featuring smashburgers, pasta salad and scrumptious sweets. These classic dishes can be prepared indoors or out, making them the perfect recipes for backyard dinner parties on warm summer nights. (Cooking) - 2023-05-18

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - The Future is Flavor
tastemade.us.description: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience. (Cooking) - 2021-10-22

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - The Big Game
tastemade.us.description: Brackets are complete and all that's missing is food to fuel your team's run. Huddle around the kitchen as Frankie preps the ultimate watch party spread. These savory, spicy and sweet dishes are championship-worthy even if your bracket goes bust. (Cooking) - 2022-03-11

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart
tastemade.us.description: Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
tastemade.us.description: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
tastemade.us.description: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Pioneering From Farm to Table
tastemade.us.description: Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemade.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos
tastemade.us.description: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemade.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemade.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemade.us.description: Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
tastemade.us.description: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Wild Boar Playbook
tastemade.us.description: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Back to Our Caveman Roots
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird
tastemade.us.description: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Wild Seafood Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
tastemade.us.description: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - A Whole Roasted Hog
tastemade.us.description: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog. (Cooking) - 2023-09-06

tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice. (Cooking) - 2024-03-26

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 New Alliances The complex web of alliances and partnerships forms as the conflict expands; the entry of the Soviet Union and the United States into the war shifts the balance of power; exploring the significance of Japan's imperial ambitions.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E10 The Battle for Iwo Jima The U.S. marines fight a battle at Iwo Jima against the Japanese, and the American navy also fights the typhoon.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Great Tank Battles
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 The Superior Force On June 22, 1941 the Germans launched Operation Barbarossa, the code name for the invasion of the Soviet Union.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Alone Germany seeks to neutralize British strength from the air; Erwin Rommel drives the Allies back in North Africa; Japan controls most of the eastern coastal area in China, but suffers heavy losses.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Leibstandarte: Hitler's Elite Body Guard
combatwarchannel.us.description: Adolf Hitler raised a group of 200 men, who were brought together and pledged themselves to defending the life of the man whose name they wore on their sleeves so proudly.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E14 Big Picture: A Day in Korea Comparing of the life of the individual in the states to the soldier on the front lines of Korea.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E01 Erwin Rommel Field Marshal Rommel was praised by Churchill and Hitler, revered by troops and respected by foes; once Hitler's adviser, he later joined a plot to kill him; his legacy remains controversial.

combatwarchannel.us.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 Marines With Wings US and ARVN forces conduct a series of sizable amphibious operations along the Mekong River Delta.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Concentration Camps Liberated in Germany In April 1945, Allied troops uncovered and liberated numerous camps; it was only when camps like Ohrdruf, Buchenwald and Dachau were opened in Germany that the world truly grasped the scale of the horrors inflicted by the Nazis.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlefields
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 1942 The Dieppe Raid On August 19, 1942, after nine hours of fighting, 1,197 allied soldiers, including 913 Canadians, are killed; 48 French civilians are dead; at the height of the fighting, the attackers lost four men per second; the Dieppe raid turned into a massacre.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Battles Won and Lost
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 The Tactics Campaigns are waged against non-military targets to undermine morale; when traditional methods fail, suicide attacks are launched.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Partisan War Soviet Partisans create "no-go" areas for German troops.

combatwarchannel.us.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E12 Siege of Khe Sanh The strategic Marine Corps base at Khe Sanh was located a few miles from the borders of North Vietnam and Laos.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Third Reich in Colour
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 The Liberation of France In 1944, in southern England, Allied troops are getting ready to land in Normandy. US soldier Jack Lieb is there with his amateur camera. On D-Day, John Ford shoots in color with his camera crews.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft -- WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: A look at aircraft used by military forces in the 20th century.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Swallows
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Episode 2 Zhenya asks Marina Raskova to intercede for Galya; Raskova gives the order to release Shevchenko from the tribunal and reinstate her as navigator under the command of Zvonareva.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Hitler and Churchill: The Eagle And the Lion
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Archival footage of the conflicts between Winston Churchill and Adolf Hitler during World War II.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E15 Daring Commanders - The Doolittle Raid and The Stilwell Road James "Jimmy" H. Doolittle and Joseph Warren Stilwell.

combatwarchannel.us.title: German Fighters
combatwarchannel.us.description: Germany's front line fighters in World War II; pilots who flew the planes and officers who sent them into battle.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Bombers
combatwarchannel.us.description: During the winter of 1943-1944, RAF Bomber Command was sending massive raids almost every night into the heart of Germany.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Josef Goebbels Joseph Goebbels is widely known as the master of propaganda because he harnessed the combined power of radio, print, posters, film and oratory to shape the Nazi political agenda.

combatwarchannel.us.title: After Hitler
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 In the second part of the documentary, the Marshall Plan is examined more closely. In addition, flight and expulsion, the division of Germany and the air bridge to Berlin are also covered.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Blitzkrieg The Japanese turn back a Chinese counter-offensive; the Blitzkrieg Germany invasion of France; France falls; the British Army is evacuated from Dunkirk.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E23 Churchill's Finest Hour (April - June 1945) The Russians enter Berlin first; Hitler takes his own life in his bunker; the war in Europe finally comes to an end; Churchill leads the people of Britain in the VE Day celebrations; the fighting continues in the Pacific.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E01 White Startline Howan leaves her snowy village for the big city to try and debut as an artist.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E02 Yell and Response After they sing together in the street, Ruhuyu and Delmin show Howan around Under North Zawa.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E03 On the Bike A band of high school delinquents called DOKONJOFINGER do community service; Howan looks for a job.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E04 No Problem! The girls have a hot pot party to celebrate Howan's job interview, but something's up with Ruhuyu and Delmin.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E08 A Day in Waiting Yusuke learns that peaceful moments on Hanging-Neck Island can be dangerous; Hiei faces the consequences of an attack.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E09 Percentage of Victory Team Urameshi faces Dr. Ichigaki's fighters.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E16 Friends Yuno, Mimosa, and Klaus get close to the treasure chamber in the dungeon; a mage from the Diamond Kingdom named Mars gets in their way.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E17 Destroyer In order to go to the treasure chamber with his friends, Yuno confronts Mars alongside Klaus, so that Mimosa can heal herself.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E04 Departure When the Granites nab Phryne during the Star Festival ambush, the temple authorities retaliate with an attack on the secret village in hopes of recovering the priestess.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Journey A glitch in the Granites' getaway ship has them stumped, but Clain uses his hacking skills to reveal a mischievous "doppel" that can't resist a game of hide and seek.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 The Farthest Town The Granites land their ship out of range of the Fractale system to make repairs; Clain and Phryne take in an eye-opening view of the effects of Fractale's failing structures after they meet a lone antique collector.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Veneer Town After they crash their ship, Clain and an ill Nessa find themselves in the extravagant city of Xanadu under the care of deceptively friendly "doppels."

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Secret of the Underground The high priest holds Phryne and the wounded Clain in an underground base; a Nessa look-alike shows Clain how much the temple cherishes Phryne; Sunda recruits the other Lost Millennium factions for a rescue mission.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 No Way Out After the Granites lift Clain, Phryne and Nessa safely from the rubble of the destroyed lab, the factions of the Lost Millennium face the fateful decision to unite for their best shot to bring Fractale down or surrender.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 To the Temple The battle between the Lost Millennium and the temple's forces rages on; Phryne reaches the Archpriestess and pleads to end the war and let Fractale fade out.

crunchyroll.us.title: Fractale
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 Paradise Clain is helpless behind a wall as Barrot details Phryne's role in the system, but the priest's demented rant is cut short; as the temple begins to collapse and Nessa starts to fade, the future of Fractale and all of mankind lies in Phryne's hands.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Starmine Rendezvous After some late night modifications to the IBN-5100, Okabe and his team uncover the shocking truth behind SERN's many attempts to master time travel.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Butterfly Effect's Divergence Makise figures out the rules to the phone microwave, now known as D-Mail; Okabe reluctantly adds a new member to the Future Gadget Lab staff.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Divergence Singularity Okabe takes his experimentation to the next level by texting the winning lotto numbers back in time, but he fails to consider how his actions might alter the present or the future.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 Chaos Theory Homeostasis - I The latest experiment for Okabe and his lab mates leads to the disappearance of one of their own; they attempt to use their time travel technology to make a young boy's dream a reality.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 Chaos Theory Homeostasis - II Okabe grows concerned over the drastic changes his experimentation causes, and the IBN-5100 disappears from the lab; the only hope for finding a replacement rests upon the delicate shoulders of Feyris the cat girl.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 Chaos Theory Homeostasis - III The part-time warrior from downstairs tells Okabe about the search for her missing father; a mysterious text message troubles the aspiring mad scientist.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 Dogma in Event Horizon As the lab members prepare to transport human memories by way of a Time Leap, Okabe receives some highly disturbing news that Makise may be a SERN spy.

crunchyroll.us.title: Steins;Gate
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 Dogma in Ergosphere Tension builds at the Lab when Makise and Suzuha both show up for the party; as the night draws to a close, armed thugs led by a familiar face come looking for the time machine.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E10 Glimpse Beneath the Mask A tear on the Masked Fighter's headdress provides a peek into the warrior's true identity; Kuwabara refuses to fight.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E11 Ambition Destroyed: A Trial of Light The doctor's human experiments fight against their will; as Yusuke prepares to put them out of their misery, the Masked Fighter intervenes and suggests a peculiar plan.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E18 Memories of You Asta, Yuno and the others finally get to the treasure chamber, and they're in awe at the mountain of treasure in front of them; Yuno finds a strange scroll with strange writing, and then his grimoire does something strange.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E19 Destruction and Salvation Mars gets the upper hand in battle when he badly injures Asta and attempts to finish him off.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Weekly Shounen Despair Magazine: Not Normal Arc Togami insists that the perpetrator must be a depraved serial killer, but his motives are questionable; tensions begin to rise as some of the students' darkest secrets are revealed.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Return of the New Century Galaxy Legend! O Armoured Hero, Stand Upon the Earth! (Not) Normal Arc Asahina discovers ALTER EGO, an AI created by Fujisaki; both Ishimaru and Yamada are taken with the program, but neither boy is keen to share.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Return of the New Century Galaxy Legend! O Armoured Hero, Stand Upon the Earth!: Not Normal Arc When two students are killed, one after the other, all the clues seem to point toward Hagakure, but Naegi questions the evidence.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 All All Apologies: (Not) Normal Arc Monokuma admits that he planted a mole and generously offers to let the students know who it is; the rift between the remaining students is worse than before.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 All All Apologies II Two of the main suspects for the fourth murder case are unsure of their own innocence; Naegi attempts to piece the clues together and figure out what actually happened.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 The Junk Food of Despair for Racing Through Youth: (Not) Normal Arc The group explores the fifth and final floor, which includes a botanical garden and classroom filled with blood; Kyouko is questioned on her identity, but insists she has no memory of it, due to her amnesia.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 The Junk Food of Despair for Racing Through Youth: Not Normal Arc Naegi and the others find themselves the unwilling participants in an awkward classroom trial; Monokuma seems to be plotting something.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 The Reason Super High School-Level Bad Luck Attracted Super High School-Level Murder ... Naegi is now almost certain that the principal is not the mastermind, leaving him to question who it could be; he discovers the principal's digital notebook, filled with vital clues for the trial.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 The Girl Flautist Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe are quickly becoming close friends as they continue to protect Eggs; however, as they grow closer, questions pile up and tensions rise.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Punch Drunk Day The girls are attacked by a dangerous new type of enemy while trying to protect their Wonder Eggs; Acca and Ura-Acca may have a solution, but Ai is more concerned with the budding relationship between her mother and Mr. Sasaki.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 After School at 14 It's Rika's birthday, and the girls get together to celebrate; Rika, however, is focused on her troubled relationship with her mother, and those worries carry over into her next battle.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 The Happy Friendship Plan Acca and Ura-Acca would like to sell a Wonder Egg; they explain the Eggs and introduce four of their regular customers: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 A Story No One Knows The girls are surprised when Neiru invites them all to her house, and even more surprised to find out that she lives at her company.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 Confession Ai, Rika and Neiru confront Acca and Ura-Acca, but they are distracted by shocking news from Momoe; later, Momoe faces her toughest battle yet while Ai makes a difficult decision.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 An Adult Child The girls realize there's more waiting for them at the end of their missions; as doubts pile up and tensions rise, Ura-Acca decides to tell Ai his story.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 An Unvanquished Warrior Friendships are tested as Ai and Neiru realize how much victory has cost Rika and Momoe; Ai decides to fight again in spite of what she's learned, but the girl who emerges from her Egg this time may be more than she bargained for.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Parallelism Crown At the concert of the popular band, REIJINGSIGNAL, Howan is chosen from the audience to go to the backstage party.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Heromeans Himeko is acting strange, so Howan tries different things to get her to open up.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E09 Leeches & Shaved Heads & Tear Gas, Oh My! -- Part 1 Contestants connected to a helicopter via bungee cord are ripped off a cliff's edge; other stunts include being submerged in a tub full of leeches and navigating through a five-story building engulfed in flames.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E08 Contestants must consume live slugs. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E20 Animal Themed Clip Show Clips from previous episodes feature snakes, rats, scorpions, bulls and alligators.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E15 Blizzard Show After a "blizzard" hits, contestants must balance on a spinning Ferris wheel while dining on pizza topped with bile and blood.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E28 Submerged Hallway, Gross Items Contestants must drive a car off a ramp on top of a three-story parking garage to vie for a $100,000 prize.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E18 Couples Show Four couples compete; a member of each couple tries to free the mate from a box submerged in water; contestants must remove roaches from a candy box using only their mouths.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E19 Flatbed to Flatbed; Worm Coffin; Tumbler Contestants try to make a car jump from one moving flatbed truck to another; players are covered in worms with only a straw to breathe through.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E06 Perched on the hood of a car suspended 100 feet high by a giant electric magnet, contestants must switch it off, sending themselves and the vehicle plummeting toward a target on the ground.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E08 Helicopter Drop, Slug Bugs Contestants must consume live slugs. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E04 Stage Coach Drag; Fish Dinner; Pipe to Pipe to Pipe Contestants are dragged behind a stage coach.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E05 Contestants crash a car through a building.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E14 Spin Cycle, Stilt Walking Contestants must consume balut -- eggs containing partially developed duck embryos -- as well as liquefied liver and dead silk worms in brine.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor 2.0 USA
fearfactor.us.description: S01 E02 Jumping between two speeding trailer trucks; lying in a coffin-like box filled with 300,000 worms and eating some; human catapults.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E05 Roach Coach Contestants face stunts that include being locked in an underwater cage while their teammates try to free them, eating a lunchbox full of roaches and grasshoppers, and jumping between a bus and a car to retrieve flags.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E02 Broken Hearts & Blood Baths Four teams of ex-couples face stunts that include escaping from a submerged car and climbing on top of a moving bus.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor 2.0 USA
fearfactor.us.description: S01 E04 Contestants must climb a 110-foot tower and jump into a net; chewing and swallowing six live worms; crawling through a drainage tunnel.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E06 Hee Haw! Hee Haw! Teams of twins face challenges including racing through an electrified maze suspended over water, eating something gross and racing on a moving train while the teammate crashes through a locomotive.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E22 Helicopter Slalom, Piercings, Maggoty Cheese, Flag Snag Contestants must complete four stunts; players are pierced with long needles, and they eat cheese crawling with maggots.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E09 Dog Attack/Gas Chamber/Car Carrier Drive-Thru Contestants try to survive in a room full of tear gas. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E01 Scorpion Tales Family duos take part in stunts that include hanging from a speeding helicopter, eating scorpions, and being attached to the grill of a semi truck.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E10 Water rises in a glass closet as contestants struggle to unlock the door and escape.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E11 Christmas Fear Factor Contestants try to swallow reindeer parts; players attempt to ride a scooter across a narrow plank 100 feet above the ground.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S04 E09 In an astonishing series of experiments Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson find out just how dangerous ordinary items can be, and how you can best keep them under control in our cars.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S05 E02 Celebrating the most spectacular challenge petrol-heads have ever invented.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S05 E03 Tiff Needell meets some of the people whose lives have been blighted by a crippling fear of driving and considers the latest solutions to this widespread problem; meanwhile, Tom Ford gets behind the wheel of Mercedes' new SLK.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S05 E04 Blow Out Fifth Gear reveal how ignoring tires can be dangerous.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S05 E05 The Ultimate Mini Adrian Simpson will be in Surrey for the Mini World Show, a 45th Birthday Party for the Mini - attracting masterpieces from all over the world.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S05 E08 Vicki is the first journalist in the world to drive the astonishing £150,000 Gibbs Aquada, an amphibious car that breaks the mold; Vicki tests it out on the open road and the ocean wave.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S05 E08 Vicki is the first journalist in the world to drive the astonishing £150,000 Gibbs Aquada, an amphibious car that breaks the mold; Vicki tests it out on the open road and the ocean wave.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E01 It's the ultimate showdown, a quarter mile drag between a Formula One car, a superbike and a racing powerboat to find out which is quickest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E02 Tiff Needell tests the latest car to join the elite ranks of road cars capable of over 200mph including such mouthwatering prospects as the Enzo Ferrari, the Pagani Zonda, and the Porsche Carrera GT.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E04 Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson report on Fifth Gear's fastest ever crash test crashing a Smart into a concrete block; Jason Plato drives through five countries in 24 hours.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell drive some of the best cars made in Britain today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts to drive flat out in Aston Martin's new Vanquish S; the 520bhp, £175,000-plus super-coupe accelerates from 0-60 in 4.8 seconds and is capable of over 200mph.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E08 Tiff Needell is joined by Le Mans winner Guy Smith and former rally co-driver Tony Mason to do something that's not as ridiculous as it might sound - caravan racing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E01 Tiff heads to Anglesey to see what's quickest: a Smart Brabus or Mini Cooper S when they get pitched head to head in the Fifth Gear shoot-out.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E02 Jason Plato is given his toughest mission yet - to do one month's motoring in 24 hours; a bid to give the new BMW 3 Series the ultimate road test.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E03 Tiff heads to Anglesey for two shootouts; the Porsche Cayenne goes head-to-head with the BMW X5; the Renault Clio takes on the Honda Civic.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E09 Jon Bentley is on a mission to discover Britain's Most Prestigious Car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E06 Tom Ford test-drives the Ariel Atom which has no doors, no windscreen, and no bodywork, but it accelerates faster than the McLaren F1.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E07 Tiff Needell teams up with supermodel Jodie Kidd to race a Maserati at the Monza grand prix circuit in Italy; Jason Plato visits the Top Marques Monaco Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E08 Tiff tests the BMW M5 by driving from the UK to the famous Pau circuit in France; Tom tests the Ariel Atom.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E01 Tiff Needell test drives the new Aston Martin V8 Vantage, billed as the most desirable sports car in the world; Jon Bentley reveals definitively whether expensive petrol is worth the extra cash.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki Butler-Henderson is finding out if progress has been made by Mitsubishi, as she races a classic Evo 6 against the very latest Evo 9.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson welcomes Michael Schumacher to the show, for his only British television appearance this year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E05 Tiff tests the grand tourer's handling through the dramatic scenery of Snowdonia in Wales; Jason Plato tests the brand new £115,000 Aston Martin DB9 Volante.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson tries to crack 150 mph as she makes an attempt on the Blindfolded Land Speed World Record; can Vicki hold her nerve and set a new record for driving in a straight line?

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E08 In a superb world first, Tiff Needell gets to drive a Williams Formula 1 Grand Prix car; with exclusive access to the team, follow Tiff every step of the way.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E09 Tiff Needell drives the first Porsche Cayman in the UK along the A537, known as the Cat and Fiddle Road; he evaluates whether the notoriously dangerous route can be navigated safely and enjoyably.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson jets off to Portugal to drive the new Mazda MX5.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Tom Ford puts the Bentley Continental Flying Spur to the test; we take the fastest four-door saloon in the world on a tour of Britain and see just how many swanky events Tom can visit in 24 hours.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: The big names of the automotive world go under the hood to discuss reviews, news and bargains of the industry.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E01 Jason Plato helps a lottery winner choose a new supercar; Tiff Needell road tests the new Jaguar XK on the best road in the world; Tom Ford meets Jenson Button at the Geneva Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E02 A crash test between a Land Rover Discovery and a Renault Espace evaluates safety differences between four-by-four vehicles and multipurpose vehicles.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson is the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge; Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E05 We reveal the Best Cheap Car in Britain, meet the man who's giving away a free Ferrari to try and help sell his house, and a look round the country's ultimate supercar collection.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E06 Jason Plato teaches Girls Aloud how to become racing drivers; Tiff Needell drives the new Maserati Quattroporte, and Tom Ford tries to break the world record for doing donuts in a car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson learns how to become a spy photographer as she goes undercover trying to snap car manufacturer's secret prototypes; Tom Ford is in Japan driving the car of the future.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E09 Find out what happens if you accidentally put diesel into a petrol engine; follow Tiff Needell as he races an Aston Martin DBR9S.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E11 Tom Ford flies out on Alan Sugar's private jet to test the brand new Audi TT, Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts a new land speed record, and Tiff Needell enters the inaugural D1GB drifting competition.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E12 Jason Plato tests the new 911 Turbo, Vicki Butler-Henderson presents a high speed crash test, and Tom Ford drives a new Lamborghini.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E13 We bring you the supercar battle when we pitch the McLaren F1 against the Enzo Ferrari; Jason Plato tries his hand at flying a stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E01 "Fifth Gear" quite literally takes to new heights by staging a race between cars and planes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Direct Contact
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. (Action) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Broken Bonds
dateline.us.description: When a scientist is murdered in his home, detectives try to figure out why his wife and son were left unharmed.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Into the Night
dateline.us.description: The disappearance of a young woman from Bend, Ore., leads to an intense manhunt after the suspect embarks on a two state crime spree.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Good Husband
dateline.us.description: Police initially suspect natural causes as they investigate a man's death, until they learn about an unconventional love triangle, which points the investigation in a new direction.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Before Dawn
dateline.us.description: The investigation into the death of a pregnant woman just months after she wed her high school sweetheart reveals secret lives and feuds.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Tipping Point
dateline.us.description: The case of Johnny Hincapie, whose conviction for the 1990 murder of a Utah tourist in New York -- a case that represented a tipping point in the city's law enforcement -- was overturned after 25 years.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Stone-Cold
dateline.us.description: When a hard-charging boss in Arizona is shot to death, police uncover a complex web of bruised egos in his professional life and a trail of broken hearts in his personal life.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - While They Were Sleeping
dateline.us.description: Melissa Oxley wakes up to find her husband, Ben Oxley, has been shot in the head.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Jacket
dateline.us.description: When 18-year-old Anjelica "AJ" Hadsell disappears, the investigation into her inner circle reveals a sinister betrayal; featuring interviews with AJ's stepfather Wesley Hadsell and two of her friends.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Footprints in the Snow
dateline.us.description: The missing-persons case of 12-year-old Jonelle Matthews in Colorado remained a mystery for more than three decades until detectives narrowed in on a suspect whose bizarre behavior after her disappearance hinted at something much more sinister.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Sisterhood
dateline.us.description: After the cause of the death of Stacy Feldman in her Denver home is ruled as undetermined, friends and family join forces to piece together what happened; insiders close to the case speak out about the seven-year battle for justice.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - A Cool Desert Morning
dateline.us.description: A family begins a relentless pursuit of justice after the death of Nevada attorney Susan Winters is ruled a suicide; Susan's parents open up about the seven-year case and their efforts to push back against the criminal justice system.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - On the Outskirts of Town
dateline.us.description: When a young woman is found dead near a soccer field in Indiana, detectives try to piece together a puzzle that leads them to an unexpected suspect.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Pin at Apartment 210
dateline.us.description: A young Tennessee woman mysteriously vanishes and misses her family's Thanksgiving dinner; determined to track her down, her family takes matters into their own hands, pursuing every digital clue she left behind.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Unusual Suspect
dateline.us.description: Police suspect a serial killer when two women and their teenage daughters are murdered in Maryland; during the search for clues, it's revealed that a master thief is the key to solving the mystery.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Motive
dateline.us.description: When a young woman finds out that her boyfriend might have shot and killed a college football player out of revenge, she struggles with coming forward to officials, fearing she could lose her life.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - While She Was Sleeping
dateline.us.description: The residents of a glamorous resort town are shocked when a well-known woman from a prominent family is found dead in her home.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Deadly Valentine
dateline.us.description: A mother of three married to a missionary is found dead on Valentine's Day; the investigation into the murder reveals answers close to home.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Accused
dateline.us.description: A man who was recently acquitted of the murder of his ex-girlfriend's 12-year-old son tells his story; interview with the victim's mother and key players in the case.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Long Road to Freedom
dateline.us.description: Two Tulsa brothers fight for more than 20 years to prove their innocence after they were wrongfully convicted for separate murders.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E01 The Wizard of Oz An exploration of the dark myths and legends behind one of the most beloved films in the history of cinema, "The Wizard of Oz."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E02 Rosemary's Baby A look into the making of Roman Polanski's "Rosemary's Baby," and the tragic aftermath following the films release.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E03 Stalker Examining the troubled making of Andrei Tarkovsky's science-fiction masterwork "Stalker," and the production disasters that beset the filming: damaged film stock, earthquakes, and a sickness that afflicted the cast and crew.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E04 The Serpent and the Rainbow An exploration of Wes Craven's journey into the secret societies of Haitian Voodoo, zombies, and magic.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E05 Cannibal Holocaust A look into the making of what is arguably the most controversial film ever produced: Cannibal Holocaust.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Autopsy of Jane Doe
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: When father and son coroners investigate the death of a beautiful "Jane Doe," they find increasingly bizarre clues.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Rebekah Heath It was a mystery that plagued law enforcement for over years: four unidentified bodies found inside barrels in the woods; one woman searching for answers from her own troubled past sets herself on a journey to give the victims back their names.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E06 Josh Hallmark A young man whose childhood was marked by tragedy learns of a relatively unknown serial killer, and finds himself thinking about unidentified victims; it isn't long before that pursuit becomes a full-time job and identifying victims an obsession.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 The Mays Family A young mother is found unresponsive in bed, and her cause of death is determined to be an accidental heroin overdose; but her family questions everything about the circumstances around her death, so they launch their own investigation.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Deb & Judy A young man leaves home for the corner store, but dies on a rainy sidewalk just down the street; bystanders claim that he fell off of his bike, but his mom and sister don't buy it; they hit the streets to find answers.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E05 Lisa Coppel A young girl's life was thrown into chaos when her single mother died by a gunshot wound in their remote mountain home; the journey for the truth would be long and arduous, and it would be thirty years until justice was finally served.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 John Allore When a college student was found dead in rural Quebec, police refused to call it a murder; but years later, her brother continues his own investigation into her death; on the eve of a trip to return to the scene of the crime, tragedy strikes again.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Welcome to the Jungle When Patch O'Furr is tagged in a mysterious online post, he must face the fact that animal abusers are hiding in plain sight in the Furry Fandom; Furry Detectives comb through evidence and discover one popular YouTuber is a suspect.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Predator Becomes Prey An online 3D printing group leads to a break in the case and The Furry Detectives get their first arrest; the Zoosadist ringleader, known as SnakeThing, is still out there.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Top of the Food Chain It wasn't just animals, he was hurting people too; the self-proclaimed Furvengers must battle through legal obstacles and personal attacks as they hunt for SnakeThing.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Animal Within A video shared in the Furry community by a person named "Monster" causes a new level of vigilante detective work; clues lead to a remote shipping container in the outback of Australia owned by a well-respected celebrity.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Adel, Georgia The town of Adel, Ga., is rocked by a brutal robbery homicide, and locals quickly point to an outsider as the killer; over 20 years later, new evidence raises the startling question if an innocent man is serving life for another man's crime.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Sauquoit, New York When a beloved chiropractor in Sauquoit, N.Y., dies suddenly under strange circumstances, investigators discover she's been murdered with a rare poison; the killer could only be someone she knew closely, and the case divides the town.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 St. Augustine, Florida A young woman in St. Augustine, Fla., with everything to live for is found shot to death with the gun belonging to her boyfriend, a deputy sheriff; he says it was suicide, but her family believes it was murder.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 Cookeville, Tennessee When an immigrant couple who settled in the Tennessee town of Cookeville is executed in their sleep and their house set on fire, investigators identify a suspect with motive; in their rush to make an arrest, they may have gotten the wrong man.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Centigrade
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 The Exorcist The release of "The Exorcist" is surrounded by controversy, as reports of fainting theater-goers and mysterious on-set accidents raise questions whether the film itself is evil.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 The Omen A series of unfortunate events plague the cast and crew during the making of "The Omen," raising concerns that the film might be cursed by the devil himself.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Poltergeist A series of untimely deaths connected to the making of the "Poltergeist" films inspire rumors that the production is cursed; suspicions are stoked by rumors that real human skeletons were used during the making of the film.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Crow Years after actor Bruce Lee's mysterious death is attributed to the Lee Family Curse, his son Brandon's life is cut short due to a tragic on-set accident during the making of "The Crow."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E05 Twilight Zone: The Movie A horrific on-set accident during the production of "Twilight Zone: The Movie" leaves those involved in the making of the film cursed by the memory of the incident they witnessed.
