pickletv.us.description: S1 E26 December 12, 2023 - Welcome to the second round of the semi-finals for season 2 of The Arizona Pickleball League! It's Tuesday Night Pickleball @ The Orchard, and the Gilbert Gladiators face-off against the Scottsdale Scorchers.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : - Women's Senior Pro Doubles - Semifinal 2
pickletv.us.description: S1 E35 Suzanne LeBlang and Teresa Tarn go up against Eva Welsher and Angela Simon in the Women's Senior Pro Doubles Semifinals.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 Grand Final - Chennai vs Delhi - Day 13 Tie 1
pickletv.us.description: S2 E24 The grand finale of the World Pickleball League Season 2 descends upon Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for an unforgettable clash of titans between the Chennai Super Champs and Delhi Dilwale. Witness the technical mastery of Rika Fujiwara as she faces off against Alejandra Lopez in a high-stakes women’s singles match that sets the tone for the entire championship. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during a mixed doubles "masterclass" featuring Max Mansoor and Trang Huynh, which commentators hailed as the potential "rally of the season". With the "Band of Honor" and the ultimate league trophy on the line, every strategic "Pickle Play" and nerve-wracking volley contributes to an atmosphere so electric the crowd and commentators alike are left "going berserk".

pickletv.us.title: The PressBox Party : The U.S. Open of Pickleball and the beginning of Pickleball on national TV
pickletv.us.description: S1 E12 With Ray Colaiacovo sitting in for Tim Ring, Dave Benz talks about the growing craze of pickleball and how Pickleball first arrived to the masses on national TV via the US Open Pickleball Championship.

pickletv.us.title: NPL : 2024 – Women’s Doubles Championship – Carter & Ojeda vs Zelenski & Kordic Mueller
pickletv.us.description: S24 E1 The stakes are sky-high in this 2024 National Pickleball League Women’s Doubles Championship as the Coachella Valley Scorpions' dynamic duo, Molly Carter and Kelly Ojeda, take on the formidable Denver Iconics pairing of Stacy Zelenski and Lily Kordic Mueller. Filmed at a championship stop on the NPL tour, this intense match features fierce net battles, pinpoint placement, and relentless energy on both sides of the court. Watch as Carter & Ojeda push the pace and mount a relentless offensive, while Zelenski & Kordic Mueller counter with sharp angles and strategic resets. A hard-fought final that captures the spirit, skill, and teamwork of professional women’s pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Pune vs. Bengaluru - Day 4 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E8 Day 4 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) presents a crucial matchup between Pune United and the high-performing Bengaluru Jawans. For Pune, this is a must-win match to keep their semi-final hopes alive, while Bengaluru is on top of their game.

pickletv.us.title: Court Kings : - Part 2
pickletv.us.description: S1 E3 Get the behind-the-scenes look of the pickleball court construction process with the Court Kings crew.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Mens Pro Double - Cangelosi/Leonard vs. Tomassi/Gancuart
pickletv.us.description: S1 E9 Catch the exhilarating Men's Pro Doubles match from the 2025 Minto US Open Pickleball Championships, powered by Margaritaville! Witness incredible action on the Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida, the paradise coast for pickleball. This thrilling match features the dynamic duo of John Cangelosi and Michael Leonard against their formidable opponents. Get ready for intense rallies, powerful shots, and strategic play from top professional pickleball players. Don't miss this must-watch event from the epicenter of pickleball!

pickletv.us.title: Atlantic City Pickleball Open 2022 : Pickleball - Women’s Senior Pro Singles Match
pickletv.us.description: S1 E4 Women's Senior Singles Match saw Jenny Klitch take on Susan Hughes.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : - Mixed Pro Doubles - Semifinal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E15 Megan Fudge along with husband Ryler Deheart faced off against Simone Jardim & Kyle Yates in a Semifinal match.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Pune vs. Chennai - Day 6 Tie 1
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E11 It's a high-stakes "Wednesday evening pickleball party" on Day 6 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as Pune United takes on the Chennai Super Champs at the CCI Brabourne Stadium. With both teams currently sitting low on the points table (fifth and sixth), this game is a crucial must-win for both, offering a chance for one team to gain much-needed inspiration and move up the standings.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : Quarterfinal - Utah Valley University vs. Indiana University
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E4 The atmosphere is electric as the top-seeded Indiana Hoosiers clash with the relentless Utah Valley Wolverines in a high-stakes quarterfinal showdown. With a boisterous Hoosier crowd fueling every point, UVU’s powerhouse duo must find a way to silence the stands and keep their hunt for a first national title alive. Witness explosive "howitzer" drives and tactical brilliance as these elite programs trade blows in a must-win battle for a spot in the Final Four.

pickletv.us.title: All Florida Pro League : GNV Chomp vs Punta Gorda Tide
pickletv.us.description: S1 E19 Gainesville Chomp and Punta Gorda Tide compete in women's doubles. Angelina and Ava for Gainesville, Savannah and Ariel for Punta Gorda. Gainesville leads briefly before Punta Gorda takes the upper hand.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - Perseus vs. Hyperion Nationals
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E6 Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Pune vs Mumbai - Day 10 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E19 Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

pickletv.us.title: Pickleball 360 : Stretch Volleys, Pivoting Footwork, Closing On The Net
pickletv.us.description: S1 E2 Learn pickleball from every angle with the World's Best Players: Ben Johns (World #1), Collin Johns (World #3), and Dekel Bar (National Champion)! Learn Stretch Volleys, Pivoting Footwork, Closing On The Net.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Pro Mixed Doubles Fudge/Munro vs. Jardim/Jardim
pickletv.us.description: S1 E18 Get ready for a thrilling Pro Mixed Doubles match featuring the number one ranked team of Megan Fudge and Jack Munro taking on Simone Jardim and her brother, Marcelo Jardim. This is the first time these two teams are facing off on the Championship Court. Don't miss the action!

pickletv.us.title: European Pickleball Championship : Senior Women's Doubles Final - Gray/Linton vs. Ramirez/Senciales
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E4 The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the Senior Women's Doubles Final under the floodlights . Team England, represented by Kirsty Gray and Anna Linton, faces off against Team Spain's Monica Ramirez and Araceli Senciales .After a strong start where England establishes an early lead, the match tightens as Spain finds their rhythm in the second game . Witness the strategic battle as Gray utilizes precision lobs to disrupt the Spanish defense , while Linton delivers powerful drives to secure critical points . In a high-stakes contest for the gold medal, England targets their opponents' positioning to close out the championship .

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : - Women's Pro Doubles - Gold Medal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E28 Parris Todd and Simone Jardim compete with Bobbi Oshiro and Megan Fudge for gold in this Gold Medal Match.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : - Mixed Pro Split Age - Bronze Medal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E20 Beth Bellamy & Yates Johnson compete with Megan Fudge & Paul Olin in a Bronze medal match.

pickletv.us.title: Picklebowl 2023 : - Mixed Doubles 1
pickletv.us.description: S2 E2 Pro-pickler Pablo Tellez and teammate basketball player Jenna Bandy compete against pickleball star Dan Granot along with PCKL CEO Mike Gottfried.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Bengaluru - Day 12 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E23 The road to the championship reaches a fever pitch at Mumbai's Jio World Garden for the second semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2. In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". With every strategic "Pickle Play" and intense baseline rally potentially deciding who advances to the grand finale, the atmosphere is electric and the margins for error are razor-thin.

pickletv.us.title: European Pickleball Championship : Women's Senior Singles Final - Linton vs. Tampieri
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E2 Witness one of the most exciting finals from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome. In the Women's Senior Singles Open Final, Team England’s Anna Linton takes on Team Italy’s Paola Tampieri at the iconic Stadio dei Marmi. Linton starts with commanding form, dominating the first game with powerful forehand drives. However, the momentum shifts as Tampieri, fueled by a passionate home crowd, adjusts her strategy to target Linton’s backhand and level the match.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : US Open 2023 – Women’s Pro Singles Semifinal – Todd vs Jardim
pickletv.us.description: S1 E30 Two of the sport’s biggest names meet in this Women’s Pro Singles pre-medal match at the 2023 US Open. Parris Todd and Simone Jardim bring elite-level strategy, precision, and intensity to the court in a pivotal semifinal showdown. Who will rise to the challenge and advance?

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Women's Pro Doubles - Semifinal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E35 Arielle Butler and Mari Humberg take on Simone Jardim and Allison Harris in this Women's Pro Doubles Semifinal Match.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Chennai - Day 1 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E2 The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues its high-energy opening day at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a star-studded clash between Delhi Dilwale and the Chennai Super Champs. Watch as international stars like Delhi’s Max "Purple Jesus" Manthao and Chennai’s Hwang Nam Lee—a former Wimbledon junior doubles champion—bring world-class precision to the court. With celebrity co-owner Samantha cheering from the sidelines and strategic masterclasses from coach Wesley Gabrielsson, this tie features a gauntlet of intense Women’s Singles, Men's Singles, and high-speed Doubles matches. Experience every "Ernie" shot, tactical "pickle play," and the longest video challenge in league history as these two powerhouse teams battle for early-season dominance.

pickletv.us.title: VANTA Blackwater Team Cup : Quality Court Defenders vs Leggetts Legends_Semifinal 2
pickletv.us.description: S1 E6 Watch Quality Court Defenders vs Leggetts Legends Semifinal 2, featuring Amber and her team. Expect intense gameplay with Amber's quick improvement and crisp volleys.

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. outlaw.us.title: Wichita
outlaw.us.description: After a group of drunken trail riders runs amok, Mayor Andrew Hope (Carl Benton Reid) of Wichita, Kan., recruits the intrepid Wyatt Earp (Joel McCrea) to end lawlessness. Armed and ready for anything, the new marshal decides he will end gun violence simply by banning guns. Soon Earp must face crooked rancher Clint Wallace (Walter Sande) and whiskey slinger Doc Black (Edgar Buchanan), vicious locals who like Wichita exactly as it is and don't take kindly to being told what to do. (Western) - 1955

outlaw.us.title: Three Godfathers
outlaw.us.description: In a town called New Jerusalem, bandits Bob Sangster (Chester Morris), Doc Underwood (Lewis Stone) and Gus Barton (Walter Brennan) hold up a bank. After a gun battle with the townspeople, the three robbers retreat into the scorching desert. There, they happen upon an ill woman stranded with her child. As the mother dies, she begs the men to take care of her infant. The fugitives want to save the baby -- but to do so, they'll have to travel back to New Jerusalem, where they are wanted men. (Western) - 1936

outlaw.us.title: Pharaoh's Army
outlaw.us.description: Abston (Chris Cooper), a Union Army captain, leads his Civil War regiment to a Kentucky farm run by Sarah Anders (Patricia Clarkson), whose husband is off fighting for the Confederates. Although cordial respect develops between Abston and Sarah, war-related incidents cause mounting difficulties and shifting loyalties. Sarah's young son draws the local preacher (Kris Kristofferson) into the situation, and, after a galvanizing sermon, a bloody confrontation is at hand. (War, Drama) - 1995

outlaw.us.title: Ride, Vaquero
outlaw.us.description: After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: The Desperate Trail
outlaw.us.description: A marshal (Sam Elliott) tracks an escaped murderess (Linda Fiorentino) who is running with a stagecoach robber (Craig Sheffer). (Western) - 1994

outlaw.us.title: Wyatt Earp
outlaw.us.description: The epic biography of western lawman Wyatt Earp, who at an early age, is taught that nothing matters more than family and the law. He becomes a respected sheriff in Dodge City and Tombstone. Joined by his brothers and Doc Holliday, Earp wages war on the dreaded Clanton and McLaury gangs. (Biography) - 1994

outlaw.us.title: Two for Texas
outlaw.us.description: Escapees (Kris Kristofferson, Scott Bairstow) from a Louisiana penal colony join Sam Houston's Texas Volunteer Army and fight to avenge the Alamo. (Adventure) - 1998

outlaw.us.title: Across the Wide Missouri
outlaw.us.description: Tough trapper Flint Mitchell is a tenacious survivor in the unforgiving wilderness of the West. Determined to stay on the good side of the local Blackfoot tribe, Flint is intent on marrying Kamiah, the beautiful daughter of Ironshirt -- especially since this union would allow him to freely pursue his trade in the region. Struggling to win the approval of the protective Ironshirt, Flint finds himself truly falling for Kamiah. (Adventure) - 1951

outlaw.us.title: Along the Great Divide
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. marshal (Kirk Douglas) leads a lynch-mob survivor, his daughter (Virginia Mayo) and others across the desert to justice. (Western) - 1951

outlaw.us.title: There Was a Crooked Man
outlaw.us.description: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak. (Western) - 1970

outtvproud.us.title: The Inspection
outtvproud.us.description: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022

outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack
outtvproud.us.description: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

outtvproud.us.title: Fatal Beauty
outtvproud.us.description: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them. (Crime drama) - 1987

outtvproud.us.title: Big Sky
outtvproud.us.description: Two masked gunmen attack a woman and her agoraphobic daughter as they travel by van to a treatment facility. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: The Cold Light of Day
outtvproud.us.description: Young business consultant Will Shaw (Henry Cavill) flies to Spain for a vacation aboard his family's sailboat. When Will returns from some on-shore shopping, his family is gone and will be killed if he does not deliver a missing briefcase within 24 hours. As it turns out, his father (Sigourney Weaver) is not a cultural attaché but a spy, and Will is in over his head. He must find a way to turn the tables on his enemies, or he and his family will all die. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

outtvproud.us.title: 3 Generations
outtvproud.us.description: Hoping to get support from his mother (Naomi Watts) and grandmother (Susan Sarandon), a New York teen (Elle Fanning) prepares to transition from female to male. (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: Generation Um...
outtvproud.us.description: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera. (Drama) - 2012

outtvproud.us.title: Freeway
outtvproud.us.description: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1996

outtvproud.us.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
outtvproud.us.description: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all. (Horror, Thriller) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: The Grudge 3
outtvproud.us.description: Jake (Matthew Knight), who nearly lost his mind after battling a vicious Japanese curse, is living in a mental hospital. Dr. Sullivan (Shawnee Smith) is assigned to determine if his wild stories are true. A trip to Jake's apartment convinces her that they are, and Sullivan soon discovers that the vengeful spirits Toshio (Shimba Tsuchiya) and Kayako (Aiko Horiuchi) have latched onto a new family. Only the mysterious Naoko (Emi Ikehata) knows how to stop them once and for all. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps
outtvproud.us.description: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

outtvproud.us.description: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf. (Horror) - 2004

shoutmovies.us.title: Security
shoutmovies.us.description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

shoutmovies.us.title: Animal Factory
shoutmovies.us.description: Sentenced to the state penitentiary for dealing drugs, a middle-class young man (Edward Furlong) seeks protection from a savvy inmate (Willem Dafoe).

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Massive Luxurious Living Our first home is located in Hancock Park, a recently renovated 1928 estate. Then we tour an English-inspired manor in Bel Air. Afterward we travel to Australia, and then lastly we take a tour of a massive home in the Hollywood Hills.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 Impressively Large Estates Our first home is in Beverly Hills, California. A 10,000 square foot estate that sits above the city. A six level landmark home in New York City. To Australia to visit a home with a unique design. To Beverly Hills to see a 7,000 square foot estate.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E09 American Riviera Our first home is a sprawling and beautiful estate located in Montecito, California. Then we see a European inspired Montecito mansion. To Sydney, Australia to visit a house with water views. Then Hollywood Hills to witness an architectural gem.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Incredible Private Estates Our first home is located in Palm Springs, then we get an exclusive peek inside an incredible private estate in the Hollywood Hills. Next we travel to Hampton, Australia, and then we take a tour of a resort-like home in Park City, Utah.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E01 Extraordinary Beverly Hills Today on Luxury Homes Revealed we get an exclusive tour of an extraordinary Beverly Hills mansion. On our way check out an amazing family home in Newport Coast. We travel to Merricks, Australia to visit a modern farmhouse. Then back to Beverly Hills.

tastemadehome.us.title: Luxury Homes Revealed
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Breathtaking Panoramic Views Our first home is located in the Hollywood Hills, which has panoramic views of the city. Then we tour this top level Brooklyn penthouse with breathtaking views. Traveling to Armadale, Australia, and then we tour an exclusive home in West Hollywood.

tastemadehome.us.title: Tastemade's Reno Rundown
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Home Styles On this episode, we explore three different home styles and how you can incorporate them into your own DIY projects! From Boho, to Mid-Century and Rustic, you'll be sure to find your next home reno inspo!

tastemadehome.us.title: Tastemade's Reno Rundown
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Space Race On this episode, we'll be showing you how to make the most of your space: from the kitchen and dining areas, all the way to the bathroom and living spaces. Get ready, because we're about to win the space race!

tastemadehome.us.title: Tastemade's Reno Rundown
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Pet Projects Every week we share some exciting DIY home refresh projects, so break out those hammers and mix that paint!

tastemadehome.us.title: Tastemade's Reno Rundown
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Outdoor Projects On today's episode, we hit the great outdoors! Your outdoor space is a great place to host, relax and enjoy. From refreshing your backyard to rearranging your patio, let's help make your outdoor space the place to be!

tastemadehome.us.title: Tastemade's Reno Rundown
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Home Time Is Family Time! Whether they are your family, your furry friends or even just your bestie, home time IS family time. On today's episode, we're going to show you how to make the most of your quality time by making the most of your home. Let's go!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Invest In Your Kitchen Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! And back in the city, Whitney is struggling to make her townhouse function properly. Nicole and Caffrey bring their magic to transform this townhouse!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 A Dream Childhood Home Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Townhouse Transformation Nicole and Caffrey transform a townhouse into an absolute dream for Nicole and her two daughters, while helping real estate pro Chris uncover and stage this cluttered suburban listing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

shadesofblack.us.title: Shottas
shadesofblack.us.description: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways. (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: Fled
shadesofblack.us.description: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
shadesofblack.us.description: The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. There is a tagger who discovers that not all gangsters die hard, a foolish Texas oil fortune heir who kills for money but can't afford to stay living, and a huge rap star who uncovers a few skeletons in his dressing room that try to kick down his door. (Horror) - 2006

shadesofblack.us.title: April Fools
shadesofblack.us.description: A cruel prank on April Fool's Day has deadly consequences for a group of Chicago teenagers. (Horror, Thriller) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: Rocksteady
shadesofblack.us.description: B.C. (Cedric Sanders), the only black kid on the racetrack, uses dirt track racing as a way to reach manhood. (Drama) - 2010

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly
shadesofblack.us.description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. (Crime drama, Thriller, Music) - 1998

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly 2: Millionaire Boyz Club
shadesofblack.us.description: After eight years in prison, G (Jayceon Taylor) is released and returns to his old ways on the streets -- until he starts to fall for a policewoman (Shari Headley). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Give Me Your Life
shadesofblack.us.description: As Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Harriet prepare to leave for their honeymoon, Forbes (Carl Weathers) clashes with a charismatic cult leader (Peter Fonda) who has arrived in Sparta. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
shadesofblack.us.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994

shadesofblack.us.title: Monster's Ball
shadesofblack.us.description: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband. (Drama, Romance) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together. (Cooking) - 2024-02-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Hunting for Ancient Spices in Thekkady
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits the lush plantations of spices in Thekkady and then tours Madurai, the spiritual heart of Tamil Nadu, to find hidden gems with the help of a local food journalist. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-12-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Outrageous Street Food of Pondicherry
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke uncovers the history of Chettinad and savours its famous cuisine. He then tastes the chutneys in Kumbakonam and explores the exciting food scene in Pondicherry. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-12-12

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Celebrating Diwali in Chennai
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Chennai, the capital of Tamil Nadu, a bustling city with historic ancient temples, and a vibrant modern art scene. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-12-19

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Exploring the Night Markets of Bangalore
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke heads to the city of Bangalore in southern India; he visits MTR, one of the oldest coffee houses in the city; he learns how to make idli; he meets up with a friend to explore the night markets. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-11-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin's best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin' beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird, but the food is fabulous. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-09-13

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Brooklyn's Best Pizza Tour
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He'll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he'll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-09-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio's best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-09-28

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-10-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-10-12

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Fish Tacos, Bacon Burgers & Bucatini in San Francisco
tastemadetravel.us.description: Let's dig in. Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Francisco's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From classic diner bites to fusion feasts to waterfront fish tacos, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Chicken Fried Steak, BBQ & Biscuits in San Antonio
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ready for Texas-sized flavors? Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Antonio's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From authentic Tex-Mex to Hill Country BBQ, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Smothered Pork Chops, Ramen & Fried Flounder in Charleston
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pull up a seat and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through Charleston, South Carolina's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From coastal soul to Lowcountry classics, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Picasso Pasta, Custard Cups & Cowboy Steaks in New Jersey
tastemadetravel.us.description: Grab your fork and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through New Jersey's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From silky custard cups to pasta Picasso to giant pizza slices, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - BBQ, Pizza, & Noodles in Nashville
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie visits Nashville for smoky BBQ Pork, hand-pulled noodles, a luxe burger, and hand-pulled noodles. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - No Sleep Til Brooklyn
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds gets neighborhood goodness at Bonnie's, a truly original Cantonese American concept, mind-blowing plant-based bites and retail at Aunts Et Uncles, and chophouse revival at Gage & Tollner. Plus art galleries, shopping and best pizza. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - Taking a Big Bite out of Boston
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds explores heritage-inspired spots in Boston including La Royal, dinner party-inspired Peruvian seafood restaurant, handmade German goodness at Bronwyn and over-the-top tiki culture at Wusong Road; plus the best oysters in town. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - Leveling Up in New York City
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds explores cutting edge concepts in NYC including Michelin star-winning Contra and Wildair, Madame Vo, a Vietnamese restaurant inspired by powerful women, and Dhamaka, an explosive Indian eatery. Plus shopping, art and best sandwiches. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - The Soul of Los Angeles
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds hits restaurants inspired by heritage, including Cobi's - where maximalism meets Southeast Asian, the California comfort food of Alta Adams and Yangban Society's colorful Korean-American deli concept. Plus the best tacos in LA. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - LA's Hometown Hero
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds spins through his hometown of L.A. visiting Chifa, a fashion-infused Peruvian/Chinese restaurant, authentic Mexican at La Casita Mexicana and Motherwolf - Evan Funke's opulent Roman spot. Plus art galleries, shopping and burgers. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Jakarta's King of Street Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food". (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hacienda Ranch Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
tastemadetravel.us.description: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tradition and Innovation
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja. (Cooking) - 2024-03-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favourite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chilli Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S20 E38 Pond Maintenance; Demilune Table Finishes for brick and concrete; maintaining a small backyard pond; building a three-legged Demilune table.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S20 E39 Pizza Oven Repair; What Is It? Track saws; repointing an outdoor pizza oven; a 20th anniversary "What Is It?" segment.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S21 E01 Water Heater Autopsy; Composting Cutting open a retired water heater and diagnosing why it failed; Jenn Nawada talks about her love of educating children about the outdoors; building a compost bin for a net-zero elementary school.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S21 E02 EV Chargers; China Cabinet Repair Heath explains the three levels of EV chargers; Mark weighs pros and cons of different brick patterns; Nathan helps a homeowner repair a cracked built-in china cabinet using MDF panels; Mauro repaints a china cabinet and shows how to paint on MDF.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S21 E03 Doorbell Retrofit; Driveway Edging Installing a doorbell with new wiring; bottle traps; replacing a brick driveway's edging with cobblestones.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E14 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Mid-century Modern Makeover Tommy and Kevin cruise around Brookline, Mass., in a '57 Chevy before rolling up to the latest project: a lackluster 1957 mid-century modern house in need of a total overhaul; they learn about the full scope of work, and Charlie starts in on demo.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E15 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Next-generation Demolition While old fixtures are salvaged and asbestos is removed at the house, Norm, Richard and Kevin head back to where it all began 40 years ago, in Dorchester, MA.; Roger starts to remove a tree that's threatening the property.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E16 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Apprentices in Sill School Norm teaches the apprentices how to lay a sill on the new foundation; Richard scopes the sewer to see what might be lurking inside; Kevin, the homeowners and their designer start in on a plan to create a sleek, modern space.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E17 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Beam Me Up, Tommy The foundation of the house has no footings, so Mark McCullough pours a buttress; Kevin visits the 2001 Manchester by the Sea project; back at the house, Richard solves a ductwork puzzle while Kevin and Tommy install a PVC trim overhang.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E18 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Norm Revisits a Skylight Kevin meets electrician Heath Eastman to learn about in-counter outlets; Tommy visits former apprentice Nathan Gilbert to see what he's been up to over the past year; back at the house, Norm teaches Carly how to frame a skylight.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E19 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Stone Cold Pavers Jenn and the homeowners select pavers for hardscape; Tommy and Norm install a skylight in the bathroom, while the sewer line and water main are completely replaced out front; the original foundation is also repaired.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E20 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Eight Is Enough Stairways Tommy teaches Kevin how to calculate the riser height for a set of stairs; the foundation is insulated with a DIY foam system; radiant heat is installed; Norm and Richard head to Santa Fe to visit the project they did 30 years ago.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E21 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Can We Cantilever Tommy shows Kevin the careful process of installing rafters for a cantilevered roof; Richard solves a venting problem for the kitchen sink before tackling the AC ductwork puzzle; Tommy and Kevin install snow cleats on the roof.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E22 Brookline Mid-Century Modern House: What's the Miter With the Corner Mark rebuilds a century old pudding stone wall; Tommy and Kevin revisit the 2005 Cambridge modern project; Heath Eastman installs trimless LED recessed lights; large tanks are installed under the driveway for rain water runoff.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E23 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: See Glass Kevin travels to the Midwest to see the manufacturing of plate glass and windows; back in Brookline, Mauro teaches Kevin some cold weather painting tricks; radiant heat is installed under the driveway, while the patio is installed in the front.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E24 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Attack of the Giant Tile Laying giant porcelain tile in the main living spaces of the house; Kevin and Richard head to Key West to visit the 20th anniversary project; back in Brookline, a hanging retro fireplace and modern kitchen cabinets are installed.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E25 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Finally Finishes Finishing touches abound as the project wraps up: closet systems, modern baseboards and a linear wall drain in the master shower are all installed; homeowner Sunil selects door hardware; Nathan Gilbert installs floating bathroom vanities.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S40 E26 Brookline Mid-century Modern House: Taking Modern Back to the Future After months of hard work, the lackluster mid-century box is a modern marvel once again; Kevin, Tommy and Richard tour the home and review all the special features that went into this beautiful space Sunil and Neha can now call home.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E12 Texas Techies Go Tiny Jaimie and Mike live together in a large Austin condo with their many pets; they both get on board with Mike's dream to launch his own tech start-up, and to fund it, they agree to sell their condo and commit to a tiny lifestyle.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E13 A Tiny Couple's Retreat in Louisville Charles and Myra are looking for a tiny pied-à-terre in the heart of Louisville that can serve as their weekend getaway when they're not with the kids and as a crash pad for Charles when he works late and doesn't want to make the long commute home.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Redcoats Fall to the Continental Army
truehistory.us.description: Washington's army is in dire straits; his command is in question; he revives his reputation with the famous crossing of the Delaware River; the next four years of the American Revolution, which see Britain's strategic advantage deteriorate. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - Andrew Jackson and the War of 1812
truehistory.us.description: Why the United States chooses to fight Britain in the War of 1812; America's grievances and ambitions, which include the conquest of Canada; the poor strategy, command and training that lead to a strategic stalemate; the exception is Andrew Jackson. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - America's Founding Ideas
truehistory.us.description: Start the course on the U.S. Constitution by learning about the English culture that inspired American law and the conflict with England that caused the revolution. (American history) - 2023-11-23

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - Failures of Early American Governments
truehistory.us.description: Consider where the Articles of Confederation came from. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - Dilemmas of the Constitutional Convention
truehistory.us.description: Witness the heated discussions surrounding the establishment of a new form of national governance. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: The US Constitution through History - The Ratification of the Constitution
truehistory.us.description: Reach back to the end of the eighteenth century and explore the attitudes of the various states towards the establishment of a unified federal government. (American history)

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Emancipation and the Civil War
truehistory.us.description: Studying relics and documents related to the emancipation of slaves during the Civil War era; General Lee's surrender at Appomattox; poignant stories told by artifacts from the Smithsonian's National Museum of African American History and Culture. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Gold, Guns, and Grandeur - The West
truehistory.us.description: The tale told by a tiny gold flake, which launches the California Gold Rush in the late 1840s. The Colt revolver has a profound impact; the West through the eyes of both settlers and natives in Albert Bierstadt's art; Sitting Bull's drawing book. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - The First Americans - Then and Now
truehistory.us.description: Stone points produced at the end of the last ice age by the Clovis culture of early hunter-gatherers in the Americas; the mystery of the birdman carving found in an ancient Native American burial mound; tribal traditions inspire Indian artists. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History - Planes, Trains, Automobiles ... and Wagons
truehistory.us.description: Four key artifacts that tell the story of America on the move; the Conestoga wagon; the John Bull steam locomotive; the Ford Model T; Charles Lindbergh's airplane, the Spirit of St. Louis; each represents a technology that alters the nation. (Travel) - 2014-08-22

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - George Washington's Doubts
truehistory.us.description: Explaining the importance of getting a well-rounded understanding of the Founders; Professor Guelzo explores Washington's fears about post-Revolutionary America; Washington's concerns about how people could administer their own affairs. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Thomas Mifflin's Congress
truehistory.us.description: Before the ratification of the Constitution, there are presidents of the Congress created by the Articles of Confederation; the failures of one president, Thomas Mifflin, offer a window into the problems facing the United States of America in 1783. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Robert Morris's Money
truehistory.us.description: Money issues abound in the new United States; why the abundance of land is a problem; what compels states to print their own paper money; how Robert Morris attempts to restore the links between commerce, agriculture and government finances. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: America's Founding Fathers - Benjamin Franklin's Leather Apron
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the many roles Benjamin Franklin plays in the formative years of the republic; this includes his part as an independent printer, a public "gentleman", a nobleman of nature and a tradesman cynical of the wealthy and powerful. (American history) - 2017-03-31

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - America: Forged in War
truehistory.us.description: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British. (American history) - 2018-02-02

truehistory.us.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents - George Washington Takes Command
truehistory.us.description: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War. truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - The Medieval City - A Feast for the Senses
truehistory.us.description: The sights and smells of the medieval city; exploring the rich details of markets, monasteries, churches and religious and civic events; life in the townhouses of the rich, the tenements of the poor; the activities of medieval societies. (Educational, History) - 2013-11-15

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - Rothenburg - Jewel On the Romantic Road
truehistory.us.description: A well-preserved German medieval city; exploring the imposing mansions of the city's former elite, the grand fountains and the market square with its remarkable gothic town Hall; visiting St. Jakob's Church; walking the bastions of the city walls. (Educational, History) - 2013-11-15

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - Mdina - The Silent City
truehistory.us.description: Malta's Mdina through the history of the Knights of Malta, who ruled the island for nearly 300 years; the great palaces of the nobility and their Gothic and classical architecture; the city's medieval atmosphere in the winding Moorish streets. (Educational, History) - 2013-11-15

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - Mdina and Rabat - In the Steps of St. Paul
truehistory.us.description: The Roman history of Malta and St. Paul's internment on the island; in Rabat, experiencing key sites such as the splendid Roman villa, the Grotto of St. Paul and the catacombs where Christians seek refuge; the events of the Great Siege of 1565. (Educational, History) - 2013-11-15

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - Touring the Cradle of Western Civilization
truehistory.us.description: The dynamic civilizations that emerge in the Aegean; the scope of the human drama that is played out there; some of the towering figures and remarkable sites to encounter; Professor Hale's recommendations for traveling this world as the ancients did. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - Athens - Around the Acropolis and Parthenon
truehistory.us.description: The Acropolis is a symbol of Athens; the path of the ancient annual procession honoring Athena; the history and meanings of the site's iconic buildings; the superlative architectural features of the Parthenon and its surprising original uses. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - In the Footsteps of Socrates - Historic Athens
truehistory.us.description: Treasures surrounding the Acropolis; the Theater of Dionysos, where one ponders the rituals of early dramatic festivals; the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, a venue of music and recitations; the Pnyx, an ancient hilltop assembly point; the agora market. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - Around Attica - Temples and Mysteries
truehistory.us.description: Visiting sacred monuments of Greece's beautiful Attica region; the Amphiareion is a shrine of a prophet deity; ancient oracle and healing practices; imposing shrines to Artemis and Poseidon; Eleusis is the site of mystical religious rituals. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - Point Zéro: Charting Our Course
truehistory.us.description: Contemplating the French art de vivre and the appeal that makes France one of the most visited tourist spots; an overview of the upcoming journey across the rich cultural landscape of France; learning about the iconic figure of Charles de Gaulle. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - The Birth and Rise of Paris
truehistory.us.description: Learning how Paris evolves from an ancient settlement to a Roman city and then the capital; studying medieval Paris through the Cluny Museum, the great cathedral of Notre Dame and the royal chapel of Sainte-Chapelle; following the growth of Paris. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - The Splendor of Versailles
truehistory.us.description: Discovering the Palace of Versailles as the world of Louis XIV; noting how the landscaping surrounding the palace symbolizes features of Louis's reign and how the Versailles court prizes royal spectacle; exploring Louis's patronage of the arts. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - Paris in Revolution
truehistory.us.description: Examining the social and political background of the French Revolution of 1789; visiting key locations in Paris where the events unfold, from a coffee house to the site of the Bastille prison and the Place de la Concorde; mapping Napoleon's rise. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - How Washington DC Came to Be
truehistory.us.description: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The White House and the Presidency
truehistory.us.description: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Capitol Building and the Legislature
truehistory.us.description: How the Capitol building is designed, constructed and expanded in the early years of the nation; touring the architectural and artistic wonders of the building; concluding with the House and Senate Chambers; the surrounding parks and gardens. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Supreme Court and the Law of the Land
truehistory.us.description: Studying the founding and history of the Supreme Court; touring this structure, its interior features, court facilities and artistic decoration; exploring the Court in action, which encompasses courtroom procedure and how cases are processed. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E08 Incredible Survivors A look at how some people live through the impossible such as plane crashes, freezing temperatures, or performing superhuman feats while in danger; remarkable tales of human survival force others to reconsider what is known about the will to live.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E19 Secrets of the Founding Fathers The Founding Fathers established the pillars of freedom and democracy in the United States; more than two centuries after their bold vision came to life, new information has emerged about the agendas and secrets of these important historical figures.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S01 E09 The Oak Island Curse For more than 200 years, treasure hunters have been coming to Oak Island in search of a treasure that has so far eluded them all, and has even cost six men their lives, could it be, as legend suggests, the treasure is protected by a deadly curse.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E22 Mysterious Monoliths All over the world, there are giant monoliths that ancient ancestors carved out of solid rock.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E18 The Bermuda Triangle and Beyond All over the world are forbidden triangles that are mysterious regions where ships, planes and people enter and then just disappear; they are found in Bermuda, Alaska, Japan and elsewhere.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S02 E16 The Mystery of Plagues Examining some of the most devastating plagues in human history, as well the scientific advances to combat these diseases, including the development of Edward Jenner's vaccine for smallpox in the 1790s.

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained
unxplainedzone.us.description: S04 E11 Surviving the Impossible Humans can survive catastrophic injuries and deadly scenarios that defy the odds in ways that are inexplicable; these survivals challenge the best attempts to explain how anyone could live through such circumstances.

waypointtv.us.description: S02 E06 Kyle and Jeff hunt wild pheasants in South Dakota with their friends from BOSS.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : The Journey Within - Orange Free State of South Africa: Mouflon and Feral Goat
waypointtv.us.description: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he moves into the historic Orange Free State. After incredible hunts in the Eastern Cape and Northern Cape, Mark is shifting his focus to two unique and challenging species: Mouflon and Feral Goat.

waypointtv.us.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within : South America Upland Slam-Entre Rios
waypointtv.us.description: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground with flocks of pigeons.

waypointtv.us.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within : South America Upland Slam- Patagonia
waypointtv.us.description: As an avid bird hunter who grew up sharing his passion with his dad, Mark Peterson has traveled the globe pursuing his favorite game. After completing the North America Upland Slam and the New Zealand Wingshooting Slam both in a single season.

waypointtv.us.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within : South America Upland Slam-La Pampa
waypointtv.us.description: On day three of Mark Peterson's South America Upland Slam, the team is snowed in while waiting for better weather in La Pampa. Once cleared to fly, they arrive and head straight to the field.

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : Annual Turkey Tour
waypointtv.us.description: It's turkey time and The Bearded Buck crew is going on a tour! Starting in Florida, Jerry and Austin are hunting Osceolas with Jeff Budz. From there, Jerry and Cud are headed out to hunt with our good friend, Ron Kendra,in his home state of Virginia.

waypointtv.us.title: American Heroes Outdoors : Sturgeon Fishing on the Rainy River With Gary Guggenberger
waypointtv.us.description: S08 E01 Traveling north to the Rainy River for sturgeon fishing with Vietnam veteran Gary Guggenberger, AHO ambassador Samantha Birrenkott and co-host Mike Worden; Gary checks off a bucket list item by catching a sturgeon, and he discusses being a veteran.

waypointtv.us.title: American Heroes Outdoors : Williston Rural Fire Department Walleye Tournament
waypointtv.us.description: S09 E03 The Williston Fire Department Fishing tournament on Lake Sakakawea; sharing stories of the nation's firefighters.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Shay Williams
waypointtv.us.description: U.S. Coast Guard helicopter pilot Shay Williams recounts his career flying countless search and rescue missions.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Kristina Hoyer
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E01 In a predominantly male profession, U.S. Navy veteran Kristina Hoyer recounts her incredible challenges while becoming a Navy rescue swimmer.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: Opening Day 'Shrutter It's opening day of youth season in Alabama and Mike and Jacob are ready to work on some longbeards; right off the roost turkeys are in sight.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - THP Comes To Town The WoodHaven crew hunt all across the country chasing the wild gobbling turkey, and hard rutting whitetail.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: Don's First Turkey in 35 Years This one is special. We took Ron aka Don, a WoodHaven employee who helps assemble our pot calls, out to Tennessee for a turkey hunt he'll never forget. After 35 years of not harvesting a Turkey, Don finally gets his shot.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: Southwest Alabama Turkeys Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for - cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods.

waypointtv.us.description: S19 E02 Capt. Mike heads to Venice, LA, to explore a unique bayou technique-beach fishing for redfish and black drum in the heart of the Gulf.

waypointtv.us.title: Reel Animals : King Tide
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E03 Capt. Mike and Dallas King take advantage of a powerful summer tide, hooking into an all-out redfish frenzy where the action never slows down.

waypointtv.us.description: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : The School

waypointtv.us.description: Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's, addresses the care of natural resources for future generations; Ziehmer asserts it is the responsibility of citizens to leave resources in better condition for the future.

waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound - Alabama Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.

waypointtv.us.description: Kris and Flint Seymour hunt down a Kansas giant!

waypointtv.us.description: Follow the founders: Joe Miles / Asio Gear and Andrae D'Acquisto / Lone Wolf Custom Gear as they hunt big bucks in Iowa, Texas and Mexico!

waypointtv.us.description: Join Austin and his friend DJ as they head afield in an attempt to double up on spring gobblers.
