waypointtv.us.description: Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project
waypointtv.us.description: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

waypointtv.us.description: Tyler sets up before daylight, calls in a stubborn gobbler and gets a second chance at the bird that's been haunting him.

waypointtv.us.description: The Big Eight shows up once again in front of Pitts; he hopes to be able to get a shot this time.

waypointtv.us.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within : North American Deer Slam- Giant Mexican Texanus Whitetail
waypointtv.us.description: Mark Peterson continues his journey through Mexico in pursuit of the elusive Mexican texanus whitetail. With cooler temperatures setting in and buck activity on the rise, conditions are lining up for an action-packed evening in the field.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Deer Day
waypointtv.us.description: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt as they tag alongside Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day.

waypointtv.us.description: Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support armed forces veterans and first responders to share their stories and unite all in honoring and recognizing their service to the nation.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : The Plan for POPE!
waypointtv.us.description: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade does more summer food plot prep in hopes Pope will make an appearance! With Rain on the way Slade is able to disk and seed his Pope Summer spot!

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Fortified Cottonseed
waypointtv.us.description: Joining John Sewell and Laramie Barrett from Fortified Cottonseed; Laramie gets to see first hand how their product works in the field as John has implemented it 365 days a year.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Heading North, Missouri Food Plot Prep
waypointtv.us.description: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade and the crew head north to scout out, plan, and put in the plots to lay the groundwork for this falls hunting season in the Midwest!

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Missouri Turkey Tour!
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Daily Life
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E13 Lori tags her first turkey of the season as well as the daily grind and comments from the office in McComb, Miss.; the ladies in the office aren't too fond of turkey season until it's their turn.

universalmovies.us.description: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.

universalmovies.us.description: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

universalmovies.us.description: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.

universalmovies.us.title: The Unborn
universalmovies.us.description: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.

universalmovies.us.title: The Forest
universalmovies.us.description: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.

universalmovies.us.title: Dead Silence

universalmovies.us.title: Unfriended
universalmovies.us.description: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.

universalmovies.us.title: Black Christmas
universalmovies.us.description: As sorority sisters prepare for holiday parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout their campus. Refusing to become victims, the girls decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

universalmovies.us.title: Nocturnal Animals

universalmovies.us.title: Land of the Dead
universalmovies.us.description: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.

classica.us.title: Neun Sinfonien verändern die Welt

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 15
classica.us.description: Lars Vogt ist Solist in einer Aufführung von Beethovens erstem Klavierkonzert. Das Orchestre de Paris wird von Herbert Blomstedt dirigiert. Die Aufnahme entstand 2013 im Salle Pleyel in Paris. (Music) - 2020-03-22

classica.us.title: Beethovens Violinkonzert und Bizets Symphonie in C

classica.us.title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
classica.us.description: In den 1980-er Jahren schuf Philip Glass Musik nach dem Werk "Descent into the Maelstrom" des amerikanischen Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. Die Kurzgeschichte handelt von zwei Fischern, die in Sturzbächen in den Lofoten gefangen sind. (Special, Documentary, Music) - 2019-02-10

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 9 in d-Moll, op. 125

classica.us.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018

classica.us.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 6 BWV 1019

classica.us.title: Welser-Möst dirigiert Farrenc & Mussorgsky/Ravel
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester mit einem Programm, das im März 2023 im Severance Music Center in Cleveland aufgezeichnet wurde. Auf dem Programm sind Louise Farrencs Sinfonie Nr. 3, Ravels Klavierkonzert in G-Dur mit Víkingur. (Special) - 2026-05-23

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Sinfonie Nr. 8 in G-Dur, op. 88
classica.us.description: Anlässlich des 30-jährigen Jubiläums der Musikschule Reina Sofía in Madrid, Spanien, tourte das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet durch Europa. classica.us.title: Johan de Meij: Echoes of San Marco & Fellini
classica.us.description: Dieses Konzert ist die Frucht der Kooperation der Konservatorien Giuseppe Nicolini und Giuseppe Verdi. Auf dem Programm stehen Werke des niederländischen Dirigenten und Komponisten Johan de Meij. Echoes of San Marco ist eine Hommage an den venezianischen Renaissance-Komponisten Giovanni Gabrieli. Echoes of San Marco beginnt mit einem Zitat aus Gabrielis Canzon Septimi Toni aus der Sacrae Symphoniae und wurde genau wie das Originalwerk für zwei Chöre aus Blechblasinstrumenten komponiert. (Special, Music, Entertainment) - 2019-02-01

classica.us.title: Verdi, Messa da Requiem
classica.us.description: Giuseppe Verdi (1813-1901): "Messa da Requiem". Anja Harteros (Sopran), Elīna Garanča (Mezzosopran), Jonas Kaufmann (Tenor), René Pape (Bass), Chor und Orchester des Teatro alla Scala; Leitung: Daniel Barenboim. Verdis "Requiem" zählt neben Ludwig van Beethovens "Missa solemnis" und Johannes Brahms' "Deutschem Requiem" zu den großen Meisterwerken geistlicher Musik des 19. Jahrhunderts. Für diese Aufführung in der Mailänder Scala wurden vier herausragende Solisten verpflichtet. (Special, Music, Event) - 2014-11-23

classica.us.title: Jaroussky singt Bach & Telemann
classica.us.description: Philippe Jaroussky ist der Superstar der hohen Töne. Auf dem Höhepunkt seiner Karriere gastierte er bereits auf fast allen Bühnen der Welt. Für die Konzertsaison 2015/16 hat er sich einen langersehnten Traum erfüllt: Mit Unterstützung des herausragenden Freiburger Barockorchesters widmet er sich den Kantaten Bachs und Telemanns.
